episodes.name: Welcome to Charmswell
episodes.summary: It's Sofia's first day of royal magic school, and she teams up with new friends to win a race and gets a magical visit from Rapunzel.

episodes.name: Abracadazzle/Show and Spell
episodes.summary: Sofia joins a magical challenge against students from the other castles. Layla tries a levitation spell but instead reveals her ability to sprout butterfly wings.

episodes.name: Give it a Twirl/The Tippity Tap Dance
episodes.summary: Sofia and Layla co-captain a magical parade, but they can't agree on anything. Zane uses magic to improve his dance moves but when the charm becomes a curse, Sofia helps solve it.

episodes.name: Magic Mayhem/Royal Mix It Up
episodes.summary: Camila wants to be Cedric's apprentice but causes chaos with advanced spells. Sofia is paired up with Zane's sister Zaria for a tri-castle activity, but they have nothing in common.

episodes.name: A Royal Family Picnic/The Royal Playdate
episodes.summary: While on a family picnic, Amber wants to prove she's just as amazing as Sofia. When Layla meets Sofia's siblings, Amber and James, she goes to extreme lengths to impress them.

episodes.name: New Horse on the Block/The Green-Eyed Monster
episodes.summary: Sofia and her new flying horse Wildfyre try out for the Charmswell Flying Derby. Wanting to be good at potions, Zane accidentally creates out-of-control Green-Eyed Goo Monsters.

episodes.name: Sleepy Time Spell/Zane the Hero
episodes.summary: At a sleepover at Sofia's castle with Camilla and Layla, stuffies magically come to life. A grumpy dragon is on the loose at Charmswell, and Zane tries to tame the bumbling beast.

episodes.name: Veggie Good Deed/The Lilygnome
episodes.summary: Wanting to do a good deed, Amber helps Sofia with the village feast but causes some magical problems instead. Sofia needs Layla's help to tame a mischievous magical flower.

episodes.name: The Truth

episodes.name: Episode #8.6

episodes.name: Reborn

episodes.summary: Both Beverly and Crenshaw are on a hot streak in their respective games; Amina struggles with her decision to run for Stu-Co president when she discovers her campaign speech falls on a very difficult day; Coop attends a law panel.

episodes.name: Return of the Mack

episodes.name: Boom I Got Your Boyfriend

tt40385200.title: World War II with Tom Hanks

episodes.name: The Beginning
episodes.summary: In September 1939, enabled by a secret pact between Adolf Hitler and Josef Stalin, Germany invades Poland, plunging Europe back into war.

episodes.name: Blitz
episodes.summary: After overrunning the Netherlands and Belgium, Germany drives west as Churchill braces for an air assault and FDR races to mobilise America's industry.

episodes.name: Barbarossa
episodes.summary: The story of Operation Barbarossa, Hitler's massive surprise invasion of the Soviet Union in 1941, the largest and costliest land offensive ever undertaken.

episodes.name: Pearl Harbor
episodes.summary: Japan intensifies its war in China, triggering US sanctions and global outrage. Facing resource shortages and driven by military ideology, Japan strikes Pearl Harbor in an attack that reshapes World War II.

episodes.name: The War at Sea
episodes.summary: America's battle against German U-boats in the Atlantic and Japan's powerful Navy in the Pacific ultimately shifts the war's momentum.

episodes.name: Guadalcanal
episodes.summary: After Pearl Harbor, Japanese forces sweep through Southeast Asia. On Guadalcanal, US Marines face a brutal fight to halt their restless advance.

episodes.name: Darkness Falls
episodes.summary: As Hitler's power spreads across Europe, his hateful ideology drives persecution of Jewish people, leading to escalating violence and ultimately the Holocaust.

episodes.name: Operation Torch
episodes.summary: The first joint U.S.-British offensive of the war, inexperienced troops and leader Eisenhower face hardened German Afrika Korps and the infamous Erwin Rommel.

episodes.name: Secrets and Lies
episodes.summary: Beyond WWII's frontlines, a secret war unfolds. In rural England, brilliant codebreakers race to crack Germany's Enigma Code and alter the war's outcome.

episodes.name: Stalingrad
episodes.summary: Operation Blue: Germany battles for Soviet oil fields and Stalingrad in one of history's deadliest battles, marking a major Eastern Front turning point.

episodes.name: Italy
episodes.summary: The Allies hope to quickly penetrate the Nazi Reich via Italy but instead endure a months-long slog with devastating results.

episodes.name: Battle for the Skies
episodes.summary: Allied air forces engage in a ferocious and costly battle with the German Luftwaffe over the skies of Europe.

episodes.name: Overlord
episodes.summary: The Allies launch Operation Overlord to liberate occupied France and open a second front.

episodes.name: Long Road to Tokyo
episodes.summary: The Allies and Japan battle across Asia's jungles and plains in World War II's forgotten theater.

episodes.name: Home Front
episodes.summary: As the tide begins to turn against the Axis powers, the leaders of Germany and Japan deploy opposite strategies on their home fronts.

episodes.name: Resistance
episodes.summary: Resistance to Nazi occupation and oppression is a constant throughout the war, with results both triumphant and devastating.

episodes.name: No Surrender
episodes.summary: The Pacific campaign intensifies to extreme violence and carnage between 1944 and 1945.

episodes.name: Last Days of the Reich
episodes.summary: Allied forces push toward Berlin as the European war reaches its peak.

episodes.summary: Capt. Sandy, Aesha, Nathan and Joe start a new charter season in Dubrovnik, but two key crew members clash. New stews battle over hierarchy, and the first docking ends in disaster.

episodes.name: Last Chance for a Fairytale
episodes.summary: Six couples arrive at a grand castle in the UK to save their marriages. Secrets surface fast as drinking, jealousy, and social media drama explode. One shocking confession in therapy threatens to tear everything apart.

episodes.name: Last Crown Standing
episodes.summary: Shekinah and Sarper stay apart. Jenny explains her distrust of Sumit. Rebecca and Zied clash over control. Kara and Guillermo confront hard truths. Patrick and Thais argue about their time together. Pao doubts her relationship with Russ.

episodes.name: How to Make It Last
episodes.summary: Kara and Guillermo clash over explicit content, leading to a major choice. Russ and Pao's argument escalates. Patrick and Thais disagree about his sex drive. Sumit's therapy revelation shocks Jenny.

episodes.name: Let Down Your Last Armor
episodes.summary: Russ and Pao confront harsh relationship realities. Jenny and Sumit work to rekindle passion. Kara hopes intimacy will reunite her with Guillermo. Sarper remains angry with Rebecca. Patrick and Shekinah argue over finances.

episodes.name: The Last Chance for Honor
episodes.summary: The couples go out for the evening. Rebecca confronts Sarper over his behind-the-back remarks. Kara and Guillermo share a dance and are encouraged to kiss. Thais stands up for Patrick. Shekinah's cutting comments escalate into yelling.

episodes.name: Fall on Your Last Sword
episodes.summary: Sarper and Guillermo clash outside the bar, leaving Kara in tears. At wilderness therapy, couples split into teams and struggle to communicate while navigating the harsh terrain.

episodes.name: The Last Noble Truth
episodes.summary: Pao is upset Russ hasn't done his therapy homework. Patrick reveals new info about Thais' Brazil trip. Sumit confesses why he and Jenny can't move out. Shekinah interrupts Rebecca, sparking a huge fight with Zied.

episodes.name: The Last Leap of Faith
episodes.summary: Tension reaches new heights at wilderness therapy. Guillermo draws a line with Kara. Pao is tired of waiting for Russ to be the man she wants. Shekinah and Sarper get exiled from the group.

episodes.name: The Last Performance
episodes.summary: Jenny questions Sumit's commitment to their marriage. Patrick and Thais take a pregnancy test. Kara and Guillermo grow closer. Russ and Pao celebrate their anniversary with disastrous results. Shekinah and Sarper go to battle with the other couples.

episodes.name: The Last Draw
episodes.summary: Thais addresses her family drama with a puppet show. Guillermo opens up about Kara's drinking. Shekinah refuses to perform and walks out with Sarper. Zied's puppet show spirals into a blowout with Rebecca. Russ and Pao's anniversary ends in tears.

episodes.name: The Last Knight Standing
episodes.summary: Pao reels after fighting Russ. Jenny struggles with Sumit's lies. Sarper and Shekinah's marriage hangs by a thread. Zied's demands push Rebecca to her limit. Kara and Guillermo's date ends in disaster. Patrick and Thais face explosive family therapy.

episodes.name: Built to Last?
episodes.summary: Six couples on the brink of breakup arrive at a resort for intensive therapy. The couples must work through infidelity, lack of intimacy, and distrust in order to move forward together. Will the resort save them or break them?

episodes.name: The Last Straw
episodes.summary: The couples attend a desert retreat "Compromise Canyon" for group therapy. They carry rocks symbolizing their issues to resolve conflicts. When Gino and Jasmine have a major argument, Jasmine seeks support from a friend.

episodes.name: Save the Last Dance
episodes.summary: The couples head to a club to let off some steam and things get heated as they let loose. Ari goes missing. Natalie discovers Josh has been messaging Sophie, and Natalie decides to take action.

episodes.name: The Last Word
episodes.summary: Natalie confronts her issues after Josh departs the resort. Sex therapy unveils truths and desires, uniting some couples while dividing others. Jasmine proposes a solution for her sexless marriage with Gino.

episodes.name: The Last Rodeo
episodes.summary: Jasmine proposes open marriage, Gino declines. Sex therapy assignment unsatisfying for couples. Natalie apologizes for club incident. Men's bonding interrupted when women join their gathering. Tensions escalate between characters.

episodes.name: The Last Laugh
episodes.summary: Tempers continue to flare after a night of excessive partying. A kayaking activity challenges power dynamics. Some couples manage to work as teams while others fall into old behaviors, as not all can respect the rules.

episodes.name: If You're Not First, You're Last
episodes.summary: Julia's marriage to Brandon strains after a secret confession. Ari attempts reconciliation with Bini but fails. Jasmine struggles with Gino's rejection. Natalie and Josh confront relationship problems in sex therapy.

episodes.name: Last Minute Invitation
episodes.summary: After sandbox therapy exposes emotions, Brandon books a honeymoon suite for Julia, who throws a party instead. Florian loses his temper while Natalie searches for Josh at the resort.

episodes.name: Nice Guys Finish Last
episodes.summary: During a camping trip, friends attempt to mend Gino and Jasmine's strained relationship through unique methods. Meanwhile, Julia's unexpected revelation threatens her future with Brandon.

episodes.name: Lasting Effects
episodes.summary: Therapy sessions reveal old wounds, making Brandon question his future with Julia. Meanwhile, Jasmine suspects Gino's hiding something major, and Sophie uncovers a shocking truth about Rob.

episodes.name: Last Blow
episodes.summary: During a sweltering desert excursion, tensions explode among friends. Accusations of infidelity, relationship drama, and personal conflicts push the group's dynamics to dangerous levels.

episodes.name: On Their Last Legs
episodes.summary: The couples struggle to reconnect after camping therapy. Gino and Jasmine are at an intimacy stalemate. Ari fears her relationship with Bini is over. Jasmine introduces the ladies to her open marriage candidate. Darcey brings trouble for Stacey and Florian.

episodes.name: The Last Judgment
episodes.summary: The couples are all at odds with each another. Ari and Bini make a difficult life-changing decision. Jasmine hopes that ethical non-monogamy can save her marriage with Gino. Julia's revelation in family therapy pushes Brandon to his limit.

episodes.name: The Last Insult
episodes.summary: Darcey gets a call that threatens Stacey and Florian's relationship. Jasmine gives Gino an ultimatum to be intimate or agree to an open marriage. Brandon skips a group outing, and Julia feels unsupported. The other couples try to move forward.

episodes.name: Last Time Asking
episodes.summary: At a relationship retreat, couples face tough decisions about infidelity, trust, and commitment. Gino and Jasmine explore new boundaries, while Brandon deals with Julia's bombshell. Stacey questions Florian's loyalty.

episodes.name: The Last Frontier
episodes.summary: The final group therapy session magnifies some couples progress and reveals other couples' issues. Natalie and Josh make a life-changing decision. Stacey struggles to trust Florian. Gino and Jasmine make a big decision.

episodes.name: Peace at Last
episodes.summary: Gino talks to the man Jasmine wants to bring into their marriage. Florian and Gino come to blows at the bar. Julia gives Brandon an ultimatum. Some couples renew their vows and others part ways at the recommitment ceremony.

episodes.name: Tell All, Part 1
episodes.summary: The couples reunite to share exclusive updates on where their relationships stand since the resort. Jasmine stuns the group with the news of her pregnancy. Things get explosive when Rob doesn't hold back his opinions.

episodes.name: Tell All, Part 2
episodes.summary: The couples reunite in New York City to share how their relationships have progressed since the retreat. Brandon braces himself to face the truth, Rob and Sophie are at a crossroads, and Stacey reveals shocking news about her relationship.

episodes.name: Tell All, Part 3
episodes.summary: Florian defends his suspicious behavior, Janice exposes the truth about Ari's control over Bini's accounts, and Josh explains his reluctance to bring Natalie home.

episodes.name: Tell All, Part 4
episodes.summary: The cast explores why some of the couples have chosen to go their separate ways. Josh reveals the real reason he wouldn't invite Natalie to his home. Sophie makes a shocking claim about Rob, and Gino prepares to confront Matt.

episodes.name: Tell All, Part 5
episodes.summary: On the shocking finale of The Last Resort Tell All, the cast prepares to dig deep into the details of Gino and Jasmine's open marriage contract, and things become explosive on set between Matt and Gino.

episodes.summary: The McBee patriarch is sentenced in an FBI fraud case, jeopardizing the farm. Steven brings home a girlfriend, Cole steps up amid financial worries, and Galyna's absence raises suspicion.

episodes.name: Night of the Living Russians
episodes.summary: Cole tries to save the farm from debt while Steven balances business and romance. Galyna and Masha clash at the Halloween party after surprising security footage surfaces.

episodes.name: Cash-Strapped Cash Cow
episodes.summary: The McBee boys attend an Iowa cattle auction. With Steven absent, Jesse and Cole doubt his dedication to the farm. Cole and Kacie hit a rough patch, while Masha tries to win over the McBee women.

episodes.name: Love and War
episodes.summary: Cole prepares an epic proposal for Kacie. Alli opens up to Kacie about intimacy issues in her marriage. After encountering Steve's ex, Galyna confronts Masha to resolve their conflicts.

episodes.name: Business Beef
episodes.summary: Steven makes waves when he tries to give his new girlfriend a cut of Kacie's beef tallow business. Alli confronts Jesse about their marital issues. Masha enlists an unlikely ally to help her with a photoshoot.

episodes.name: First Impressions and Final Farewells

episodes.name: Russian Roulette
episodes.summary: Steven plans to rescue the struggling farm, while his younger brother Cole has a different vision for its future.

episodes.name: Ditched for Dallas
episodes.summary: The truth as to why Calah has been estranged from the family is revealed, forcing her to make a huge choice. Kristi, the McBee's mother and ex-wife to their father, joins her sons to help them through their time of need.

episodes.name: The Great Chicken Massacre
episodes.summary: Calah and Steven's relationship changes unexpectedly. Galyna reacts badly to ex-friend Masha vacationing with Steve Sr. Cole and Kacie learn baby's gender. Jesse presents Alli with an ultimatum before wedding.

episodes.name: Day Drinkin'
episodes.summary: Steven arranges mediation between Galyna and Masha over suspected workplace drinking. Though separated, he invites Calah to join a family Ozarks trip, which she accepts with ulterior motives.

episodes.name: Hurricane Calah
episodes.summary: The McBees return to Lake of the Ozarks. After paintballing and poolside drinks, Steven and Calah's relationship faces a crisis. Meanwhile, Kacie doubts Cole's claims of personal growth.

episodes.name: Never Seen a Rock So Big
episodes.summary: Cole plans a surprise babymoon to make amends with Kacie after the Ozarks incident, risking the farm. Steven faces business partner issues and seeks his mother's help with Galyna.

episodes.name: Nashville Hot
episodes.summary: Steven plans a Nashville "work" trip causing drama with the McBees. Jesse faces prenup pressure two weeks before his wedding. Mystery boots appear, and Galyna arrives to find she's not the only Russian around.

episodes.name: Panic! On the Combine
episodes.summary: When out harvesting, Jesse suffers from intense panic attacks as his wedding day draws closer. Cole goes ring shopping for Kacie. Steven invites a surprise guest to the wedding.

episodes.name: Russian Invasion
episodes.summary: Galyna wants a wedding invite. Drama erupts when Masha crashes her work event. Jesse debates asking Alli for a prenup. As Harvest Season ends, a $6M payment looms, leaving all uncertain if they did enough.

episodes.name: Secret Life of a Private Eye
episodes.summary: A woman in Florida vanishes, causing investigators to turn their eyes toward a member of her inner circle.

episodes.name: Strike to Kill
episodes.summary: When an Auburn University graduate disappears, her tight-knit group of friends falls under suspicion. As investigators chase leads and rumors spread, distrust grows until new evidence reveals a chilling truth about someone close to her.

episodes.name: Killer on Campus
episodes.summary: A gunman kills a University of Kentucky football player at his birthday party. Despite a house full of witnesses, no one saw the shooter. As police investigate, suspicion closes in on his closest friends who were there that night.

episodes.name: Your Smiles and Your Lies
episodes.summary: A mysterious killer murders a 19-year-old rising star in her home after a cast party. Her friends grow concerned that the culprit is in their inner circle.

episodes.name: Devil in the Hallways
episodes.summary: A missing California teenager leaves her town anxious. As locals grow suspicious, her friends question if the threat was always nearby among classmates harboring dark secrets.

episodes.name: She's No Runaway
episodes.summary: A teenager forms bonds with older individuals right before her disappearance.

episodes.name: Secrets to Reveal
episodes.summary: Best Friends take a girls trip to Las Vegas, when one of them doesn't make it home, everyone wonders "what happened in Vegas?"

episodes.name: Friendship in Disguise
episodes.summary: A killer stabs UCLA student Ron Baker to death in a train tunnel known for its connection to the Manson murders. Occult rumors then begin to spread until another missing friend redirects suspicion to Baker's inner circle.

tt32333081.title: Deadly Influence: The Social Media Murders

episodes.name: Palm Desert-ed
episodes.summary: John, Steph, Sammy, JJ, and Krista-a group of friends, take the vacation of a lifetime in Palm Springs, but when a secret relationship is discovered, it threatens to tear the group, and the trip, apart.

episodes.name: Mirage a Trois
episodes.summary: John uncovers the truth about Steph and Sammy's history, but Sammy's flirting with Krista pushes tensions to the edge. When Steph invites Krista's potential love interest Anthony into the mix, jealousy erupts -- ending in a blowout fight.

episodes.name: Palm Springs State of Mind Games
episodes.summary: Krista's roaring 20s birthday bash brings glamour, jealousy, and surprise guests as Sammy and Steph's messy love triangle creates new suspicions. JJ confronts her past, and Krista takes a big climb toward independence.

episodes.name: Sandals, Scandals, and Secrets
episodes.summary: Krista's birthday party sparks drama as Sammy distances himself from Steph after their kiss. Anthony pursues Krista, while JJ and John grow closer. After a night of Drag Bingo, John shares a shocking secret that leaves JJ stunned.

episodes.name: Feta-d Up in Paradise
episodes.summary: Steph and John come clean about the secret relationships complicating their lives. Steph's Greek-themed celebration spirals into chaos when Krista confronts Sammy about the messy love triangle threatening to tear the group apart.

episodes.name: Drama in the Dry Heat
episodes.summary: The fallout from Greek Night intensifies as Sammy sides with Krista, blindsiding Steph. When Krista overhears Steph calling her a name, tensions explode. As relationships shift, Krista demands an apology to move forward.

episodes.name: Desert Heat and Cold Shoulders
episodes.summary: Krista's first date with Anthony is overshadowed by lingering drama — and a new crush. As tensions over chores boil over, JJ and Steph bond on a bold outing, while a night out leaves the girls questioning Krista's intentions.

episodes.name: The Cost of Loyalty
episodes.summary: After witnessing her mother's murder as a child, a Bronx woman becomes a victim's advocate. Her community is shocked when her dismembered body is discovered in a park.

episodes.name: Deadly Double-Cross
episodes.summary: Two friends disappear during a shopping trip and when they're found days later, stunning secrets and shocking theories about an affair begin to emerge. Law enforcement must race to find who did it

episodes.name: Pursuing a Phantom
episodes.summary: When a nurse is abducted outside of her workplace, police race to locate her; but hope fades when video is uncovered of a mysterious man cleaning out her car and the woman nowhere to be seen.

episodes.name: Unmasking a Monster
episodes.summary: When an empty nester and healthcare worker disappears in the middle of the COVID-19 pandemic, her family fears something tragic has happened; detectives uncover a suspect whose deadly past may be repeating itself.

episodes.name: Dealing with Evil
episodes.summary: A young mother and former drug dealer decides to leave the criminal world behind, only to end up murdered; at first, it appears her past may have caught up with her, but a witness soon reveals a betrayal and motive that's far more personal

episodes.name: Burning in Betrayal
episodes.summary: When a man is found dead in his burning apartment his girlfriend admits he'd been selling drugs to make money; to detectives all signs point to a possible rival drug dealer, but will secrets come to light to reveal a more personal motive?

episodes.name: A Deadly Charade
episodes.summary: A mother is fatally stabbed, and her boyfriend is gravely wounded by an attacker right outside her home; is this a random act of violence, or is it possible the killer wanted her dead and went to unfathomable lengths to cover their tracks?

episodes.name: Deep-Rooted Evil
episodes.summary: When a single mother and nurse is found shot in her car, police look to her bitter ex-wife and current girlfriend with rumored anger issues for answers. Will detectives uncover a love triangle gone wrong, or a more sinister motive?

episodes.name: Tracing the Truth
episodes.summary: Police get a call that a young woman has been shot; the victim dies before she can tell them what happened, and the mystery caller is nowhere to be found; But an unlikely phone call could be the breakthrough that detectives need.

episodes.name: A Calculated Cover-Up
episodes.summary: Stacey Jones was a single mom who finally found someone to settle down with; but as the couple prepares to welcome a baby, Stacey is gunned down; was this a devastating hate crime or will detectives discover a shocking motive for murder?

episodes.name: A Chase for Justice
episodes.summary: When a loving mother is murdered in her own apartment, police suspect her ex-boyfriend; the case becomes complicated when detectives uncover a potential new suspect, and it will take a high-speed chase to bring the killer to justice.

episodes.name: A Threat Inked In Blood
episodes.summary: A husband returns home to find his wife stabbed to death with a message written in blood beside her body - You're next. Was she murdered by a rival gang seeking revenge, or is the cryptic threat really a cover for a killer hiding in plain sight?

episodes.name: Storm of Jealousy
episodes.summary: A man struggling with addiction and mental health is found decomposed in a hotel room after surviving a hurricane; detectives wonder if he succumbed to his past, an autopsy tells a different story as confession turns the case on its head.

episodes.name: A Vendetta in Videtta
episodes.summary: When a small Georgia town is devastated by the double homicide of a mother and her young daughter the police rush to find answers; as the case unfolds all signs point to one suspect, but will there be enough evidence to bring the killer to justice.

episodes.name: A Façade of Forgiveness
episodes.summary: A man is shot and killed in a Minneapolis street and police focus on a potential suspect seen going through the victim's pockets; however, interviews with those closest to the victim reveal a past feud and a killer determined to snuff out his future.

episodes.name: Bloody Betrayal
episodes.summary: When a hard-working security guard is found beaten to death in her home, her family is desperate for answers; more questions unfold as rumors of a shocking new lifestyle begin to spread; will detectives uncover the truth, or will the killer go free?

episodes.name: Love is Blind
episodes.summary: When a beloved restaurateur is attacked inside his popular eatery, it looks like a robbery gone wrong; as secrets simmer to the surface, detectives uncover a conspiracy motivated by lust and greed and a mastermind who may never be brought to justice.

episodes.name: The Wicked Truth
episodes.summary: When a transgender woman is found dead in her home, police fear she was the victim of a hate crime; but a recent HIV diagnosis reveals a more personal motive.

episodes.name: A Desperate Act
episodes.summary: When a hard-working Liberian immigrant is found brutally murdered, her family is left reeling; but Investigators soon uncover a secret that may have led to her death; with the trail going cold will they find the killer before they disappear for good?

episodes.name: Suffering in Silence
episodes.summary: When a young Texas couple is found shot in the middle of the night, their families struggle to think of who would have wanted to harm them; is this a random act of violence or will someone come forward to reveal a secret turned fatal?

episodes.name: Dancing with Danger
episodes.summary: When an exotic dancer is found murdered in the suburbs, her boyfriend tells 911 she went missing after an argument; police wonder if her job made her a victim of opportunity until the investigation unveils a killer weaving a web of deception.

episodes.name: The Ultimate Price
episodes.summary: When a neighbor reports an attack, police arrive to find a woman gripping to life in the street and a man dead in the home; in their search for justice, detectives uncover someone set on tearing the couple apart, but would they go as far as murder?

episodes.name: Fatal Fortune
episodes.summary: When a young woman is found shot in the head, police suspect it could be related to her job as a corrections officer; but when rumors of a love triangle surface, detectives uncover a suspect who would stop at nothing to keep the victim for himself.

episodes.name: A Sinister Rage
episodes.summary: When a popular bartender is found in her burning apartment, police suspect she is the victim of an arson fire; but will the autopsy reveal a more tragic death? detectives work to uncover who was in the apartment that night and where are they now?

episodes.name: The Last Signal
episodes.summary: A young father and aspiring rapper, who spent his life overcoming loss and adversity, goes missing before Christmas; when detectives follow the trail left by his broken ankle monitor, they uncover a shocking truth hiding right in front of their eyes.

episodes.name: Trapped in a Twisted Fairytale
episodes.summary: A young woman with special needs is found dead by her boyfriend, who tells police she was beaten by a group of women; detectives investigate if she was a victim of bullying until a bombshell discovery in her autopsy leads them straight to her killer.

episodes.name: Bound by Revenge
episodes.summary: A couple stumbles upon the tied body of a man in Atlanta's wealthiest neighborhood; police suspect his death may be related to a love triangle; a mysterious man known as "New York" could be the key to solving the case.

episodes.name: In the Shadows
episodes.summary: A devoted and freshly-in-love father goes missing when his girlfriend discovers a scene of carnage in his apartment; with hard evidence in short supply and two suspects each pointing the finger at the other, the case becomes a battle of perception.

episodes.name: Sins of the Father
episodes.summary: A mother vanishes after a fight at work, leading investigators to a trail of surveillance footage and suspicious credit card transactions. When disturbing truths come to light, what really happened is revealed by someone who knew her best.

episodes.name: Secrets Buried Deep
episodes.summary: When a woman goes missing her mother calls 911 to report her suspicions. Police soon learn of her abusive ex and a new partner with a secret. But with no leads the case goes unsolved for years until a shocking murder reveals the truth.

episodes.name: The Weight of Greed
episodes.summary: After moving for a fresh start, a young couple's dreams are shattered by what looks to be a brutal home invasion. As detectives peel back the layers, they uncover secrets and a calculated betrayal that reveals a more disturbing picture.

episodes.name: A Web of Lies
episodes.summary: When a father is found stabbed to death in his home, his girlfriend tells detectives he was attacked by an unknown group of men. But when detectives interview the neighbors, it becomes clear that this was more than a random attack.

episodes.name: Shattered Dreams
episodes.summary: After a beloved man goes missing, a wellness check leads to a gruesome discovery. When detectives uncover a mysterious woman in his life, the mystery only deepens, leaving them to dig through more lies to find out what really happened.

episodes.name: Left No Trace
episodes.summary: Devotion to family, a history of depression, and secret desires all collide to lead one nurse from a wellness journey to a path of destruction.

episodes.name: Callous Collusion
episodes.summary: A mother's morning routine turns deadly when she is gunned down in front of her son on their way to a music lesson. As detectives sift through the evidence, they uncover a disturbing story of infidelity, obsession, and calculated murder.

episodes.name: New Year's Nightmare
episodes.summary: New Year's Eve turns into a tragedy when a man is found shot inside his home. Was this just a devastating accident involving a neighborhood celebration? Or is it possible this beloved family man was the target of a calculated attack?

episodes.name: Secrets in the Sand
episodes.summary: A young woman vanishes, and her parents fear she's fallen back into the grips of her dangerous boyfriend; detectives learn about a new man in her life, and when her car is found burned, a digital clue may be their only hope of uncovering the truth.

episodes.name: A Family's Fight
episodes.summary: When a young woman disappears under disturbing circumstances, her family heads the search for answers. When detectives get involved, a guilt-ridden witness comes forward revealing shocking evidence that unveils a story of betrayal.

episodes.name: The Secrets Within
episodes.summary: When a previously unhoused young woman vanishes from her apartment, her family worries that she is once again living in a shelter. After weeks pass, a gruesome discovery reveals a horror far beyond anything they could've imagined.

episodes.name: Relentless Rage
episodes.summary: When Ryniscia Sanford is gunned down in the middle of an apartment complex, witnesses and video give police a glimpse of their suspect, who is nowhere to be found. With a manhunt underway, how long can he run until the truth catches up?

episodes.name: A Deadly Gamble
episodes.summary: When a father is shot to death in the street, police initially wonder if it's simply a robbery gone wrong. But surveillance footage and other evidence unearth a shocking setup involving several perpetrators, including someone close to him.

episodes.name: Fatal Flirtation
episodes.summary: When a dismembered torso is found buried on a vacant farm, it appears to have all the signs of gang retaliation. But will a mother's desperate search for her son lead investigators to discover a more shocking motive behind this murder?

episodes.name: Tracking a Monster
episodes.summary: An simple errand turns deadly when a young mom is shot and later dies. After pursuing the wrong suspect, detectives face a new twist when a woman comes forward with information that will take the investigation across state lines.

episodes.name: A Waking Nightmare
episodes.summary: When a young man is stabbed inside his girlfriend's home, all eyes are on her - until an eyewitness reports seeing a suspicious man fleeing the scene just moments after. Was he the killer, or simply in the wrong place at the wrong time?

episodes.name: Death in the Cul-de-Sac
episodes.summary: When a beloved father and businessman is gunned down outside his home, police believe he is the victim of a targeted attack; as they uncover details regarding his covert side, a motive for revenge is soon unveiled.

episodes.name: Unearthed Secrets
episodes.summary: When a young woman suddenly vanishes without a trace, the Cleveland Police immediately embarks upon an investigation determined to find answers; as the mystery deepens, a horrifying discovery unearths a story of deadly betrayal.

episodes.name: The Devil Inside Me
episodes.summary: When a teenager mysteriously disappears in the dead of winter, Minnesota police are determined to crack the case; as investigators begin to piece together her secret double life, a cold-blooded killer with a shocking motive is unveiled.

episodes.name: Sinful Betrayal
episodes.summary: When a mother of three is found dead from a gunshot wound, investigators are led to believe it was a suicide. As additional details and witness accounts come forward, the investigation reveals a secret double life that led to a murder.

episodes.name: Lover's Quarrel
episodes.summary: After a single mother's body is found with stab wounds in a Florida ditch, police are thrown into a case full of betrayal and deceit. Detectives rifle through her past relationships to uncover a violent killer with devilish motivations.

episodes.name: Into Thin Air
episodes.summary: When a young child is found wandering the streets of Detroit alone, a search ensues to find his missing mother; the investigation reveals a connection to a serial sexual predator, leading to a chilling discovery in a haunting saga of fraud

episodes.name: Evil Escapes
episodes.summary: When Sharonda Clark goes missing in Tulsa, OK, police visit her home and discover the young mother, stabbed multiple times; as investigators dig into her life, her past with a mysterious lover may be the clue they need to find her killer.

episodes.name: One for the Money
episodes.summary: When detectives discover a man's body on the grounds of an Austin apartment complex, they are thrust into a case with multiple suspects, conflicting stories, and startling revelations; from a night of revelry to betrayal.

episodes.name: No Remorse
episodes.summary: After a home intruder stabs 29-year-old Brian Spinks, a father and Air Force Sergeant in Shreveport, LA, police are determined to catch the killer; as detectives dig deeper, they uncover a suspect at the center of their investigation.

episodes.name: Depraved Mind
episodes.summary: When Danielle Stubbs is found dead by her family inside her home, investigators dive in to identify a suspect; but, as they race to uncover the events leading up to her death, they discover a love triangle, fueled with jealousy and rage.

episodes.name: Trail of Violence
episodes.summary: A single mother is found murdered in a hotel room, detectives fear her attacker might strike again; in a race against the clock, detectives must untangle a disturbing trail of violence involving multiple victims and one sadistic predator.

episodes.name: Deathly Betrothal
episodes.summary: When a woman's body is found in a ditch on the outskirts of Jonesboro, the town is sent into a tailspin. Detectives must determine if this was a random act of violence, or the result of her strained marriage that was splitting at the seams

episodes.name: Femme Fatale
episodes.summary: When an up-and-coming rapper is fatally shot in his San Antonio home, police are determined to catch the culprit; after discovering a suspicious 911 call placed on the night of the murder, police must track down an unexpected suspect.

episodes.name: Dangerous Liaison
episodes.summary: When a young man is found dead in a neighborhood known for illegal activities, police initially surmise his death is the result of a botched drug deal; but as they dig deeper, they learn that his desire for love may have been his downfall.

episodes.name: Out of Control
episodes.summary: When a young woman is found dead in her car outside of her home, investigators struggle to find proof of foul play. As they delve deeper into the timeline of events that led up to her death, they uncover a killer who was out of control.

episodes.name: Desperate Measures
episodes.summary: When a cryptic call reveals that a successful businesswoman has been murdered, investigators immediately jump into action; with a killer on the run, detectives must unravel the secret life hidden behind a powerful family's perfect façade.

episodes.name: Shadow of Jealousy
episodes.summary: A young mother goes missing, leaving behind her 5-month old baby. Investigators try to figure out where she could have gone. But as they interview those closest to her, they soon uncover a shocking trail of jealousy, violence, and deceit.

episodes.name: Ritualistic Obsession
episodes.summary: When severe floods lead to the discovery of a mutilated woman, investigators believe it's the work of a serial killer. As old relationships rise to the surface, they'll need to discern the lies from the truth to find the true killer.

episodes.name: I Love You to Death
episodes.summary: When a rideshare driver is fatally shot behind the wheel of her own car, detectives must track down the masked culprit. Despite uncovering surveillance footage of the incident, the case runs cold, until an unexpected witness is identified.

episodes.name: Chilling Premonitions
episodes.summary: When a single mother is found dead in her apartment, investigators theorize it was the result of a botched sexual assault. Years go by without any answers until a break in the case leaves them with more questions than answers.

episodes.name: Brutal Betrayal
episodes.summary: When a reformed ex-con is found shot outside an apartment complex, detectives wonder if his criminal past has caught up with him; but after an unexpected witness comes forward, detectives uncover sinister motives closer to home than they expected.

episodes.name: Out of the Ordinary
episodes.summary: When a teenage girl goes missing, her family is completely distraught; with no leads, detectives are left grasping at straws; when surveillance footage finally reveals a suspect, they must fight the lies to reveal the truth.

episodes.name: Bitter Rivalry
episodes.summary: When Rochelle Demmings is found dead by her boyfriend Ronald inside her home, investigators dive in to identify a suspect and the cause of her untimely death.

episodes.name: Rhyme of Revenge
episodes.summary: When a woman is found shot inside her mother's home, they can't fathom who would want to harm her; but when a suspect is caught fleeing on camera, it takes a vigilant investigation, a surprise connection and a manhunt to bring the killer to justice.

episodes.name: Dangerous Affair
episodes.summary: When a missing man is discovered deceased in his bed and with no sign of his family, detectives fear they may still be in danger; working urgently to find them before it's too late, their investigation leads to an unexpected suspect emerging.

episodes.name: Disastrous Dreaming
episodes.summary: After fulfilling her American dream, a woman suddenly disappears. Police suspect foul play and, with her family's help, zero in on a suspect; but once her body is found brutally slain, they're afraid her killer has slipped through their fingers.

episodes.name: Divine Delusions
episodes.summary: Love and stability is all this single mother wanted, but as Christmas comes around, she vanishes. While detectives rush to find answers, they are left chasing an elusive criminal; after the young woman's body is found, another goes missing.

episodes.name: Collateral Damage
episodes.summary: When a mother is found dead inside her ransacked home, detectives suspect a robbery gone wrong; as investigators piece together her final moments, more motive emerges, exposing a conspiracy and an affair.

episodes.name: Harlem Horror
episodes.summary: A loving grandmother had it all, with her home in the city and a new boyfriend; but things turn sinister when her home becomes the scene of a double murder. Soon, detectives uncover a plot that exposes danger closer than anyone could have expected.

episodes.name: The Company You Keep
episodes.summary: A beloved single mom disappears mysteriously. As police investigate her last known movements, they discover a vengeful ex-lover may be behind her vanishing.

episodes.name: Episode #15.35
episodes.summary: When a woman at the peak of her career is found brutally murdered, investigators struggle to make sense of it all. But as the evidence leads them to her killer, it's apparent he has tasted blood and now he wants more.

episodes.name: Deadly Dating Game
episodes.summary: When a beloved cancer survivor is found dead on the side of a rural highway, police fear her blossoming dating life played a role in her demise. As detectives retrace her final days, they discover an obsessive killer hiding in plain sight.

episodes.name: Devil's Playground
episodes.summary: When a beloved young woman goes missing, detectives work with her family to unearth a voicemail from an unknown number. But when it leads detectives to a disturbing scene and an unexpected killer, will they have the evidence to put him away?

episodes.name: Toxic Intentions
episodes.summary: When a dedicated educator is found unresponsive in his home, family and friends are puzzled by his unexpected passing; after receiving a tip suggesting his death was no accident, police uncover a sophisticated killer with a chilling motive

episodes.name: Shattered Ambitions
episodes.summary: When a girl is found shot in her bedroom, the investigation leaves detectives scratching their heads as the suspect list piles up. When nearby surveillance footage unveils a break in the case, detectives are shocked by what they discover.

episodes.name: Episode #15.40
episodes.summary: When a young transgender woman is discovered shot and killed, detectives work to identify her killer. After police learn their victim was attacked in a hate crime mere weeks before her death, a pool of potential suspects emerges.

episodes.name: From Hope to Horror
episodes.summary: A woman is found dead in a motel room; police suspect a drug crime; an investigation reveals an unexpected killer with a dark motive, unrelated to drugs.

episodes.name: Familial Lies
episodes.summary: As detectives interview a victim's friends and family, they discover an unassuming assailant.

episodes.name: Fame and Felony
episodes.summary: A rising young rap star is reported missing, and detectives find evidence of a violent attack in her home; yet when their prime suspect goes on the run, they are left scrambling for answers, until they get a call that breaks the case wide open.

episodes.name: The Cost of Desire
episodes.summary: When a close-knit family is brutally gunned down in their home, detectives initially suspect a botched business deal provoked the tragic massacre. As the investigation ensues, police uncover an apathetic killer motivated by greed and lust.

episodes.name: Flames of Revenge
episodes.summary: When a teacher and animal lover abandons her dogs for days, her family knows something is wrong. During the search, investigators receive a tip from loved ones, leading them to investigate a tumultuous past that blows the case wide open.

episodes.name: Deadly Arrangement
episodes.summary: After achieving the American Dream, a beloved Egyptian mother is viciously killed in the night; as the motive for the murder hangs in the air, detectives are without a suspect, until a shocking development takes the case in a new direction

episodes.name: Love and Lies
episodes.summary: A family is gunned down in the middle of the street in a quiet neighborhood, leaving a young mother dead.

episodes.name: Lured by Lies
episodes.summary: When a vibrant teenager is gunned down outside his home, friends and family are left reeling from the loss. After police discover he was on the phone in the moments leading up to his attack, the search for the mysterious caller begins.

episodes.name: Propensity for Violence
episodes.summary: On a journey to reclaim her life, a dedicated mother is murdered in cold blood inside a Minneapolis apartment; as detectives get to work, their prime suspect for this brutal crime goes on the run, and they need a miracle to bring the killer in.

episodes.name: A Volatile Situation
episodes.summary: When a young boy discovers his pregnant mother fatally shot inside their home, investigators are determined to bring her killer to justice; as they uncover details about her love life, a killer driven by a heartless motive emerges.

episodes.name: Ex Marks the Spot
episodes.summary: Jon offers a Folsom homeowner a free kitchen reno for his family of five. In three days, his team delivers improved storage, new appliances, banquette seating, and a custom drink station.

episodes.name: Loo With a View
episodes.summary: Jon Knight surprises a blended family of seven on a working farm with a 72-hour bedroom transformation.

episodes.name: Crooked Kitchen
episodes.summary: Knight and his team transform Nick and Nia's outdated, dysfunctional kitchen into a sleek, functional space where the family can cook, gather, and connect.

episodes.name: Going Hard in the Yard
episodes.summary: Jon Knight and his team transform Raemy and David's dysfunctional backyard into a usable outdoor space for their three kids, two dogs, and entire family, saving them from having to move.

episodes.name: Beyond Reason
episodes.summary: After moving to America, a single mother starts a new life hoping to find love. Her years-long search finally leads to her soulmate. But when her happily ever after is threatened, how far is she willing to go to keep the man of her dreams?

episodes.name: The Ties That Bind
episodes.summary: A young woman falls for a man who promises her the world, but his volatile behavior quickly pulls her into a dangerous web of secrets. Torn between loyalty and the law, she must make an impossible choice that will change her life forever.

episodes.name: Escape For Love
episodes.summary: Kendra Miller is a mother of four and corrections officer who falls for a convicted killer and helps him escape; their secret romance ignites a statewide manhunt, as Kendra risks everything for her man.

episodes.name: Ambush on Ash Street
episodes.summary: A young mother meets the man of her dreams; but just a few months into her relationship, she learns that her desire to have the perfect family may come at a cost; soon she is forced to choose between protecting her man and saving herself.

episodes.name: Addicted to Love
episodes.summary: Blinded by love and addiction, Laura Walton follows Deon Batton down a path of armed robbery and deception. When the law catches up, she realizes the price of devotion can be life-changing.

episodes.name: In His Line of Fire
episodes.summary: Desperate to keep Aaron Mays close, Gitano Lewis spiraled into a deadly plot of revenge and betrayal. Her loyalty led her straight into gunfire-and cost an innocent man his life.

episodes.name: The Setup
episodes.summary: When Antonetta Stevens learns her fiance is cheating, she plots revenge. With her sister-in-law by her side, she lures his lover into a deadly ambush. What she does for her man changes everything.

episodes.name: Caught in the Middle
episodes.summary: A young woman entangled in a murder investigation when her lover goes on a killing rampage and starts a war with the local police department, forcing her to choose between risking it all to protect him or losing him forever.

episodes.name: Textbook Betrayal
episodes.summary: Destynie Wright's love for Ramon Boyd pulls her into a deadly web of lies. One fateful night, a string of texts triggers a shooting that leaves her best friend wounded and a young man dead.

episodes.name: Out of Time
episodes.summary: When her marriage to an NBA superstar fizzles, a mother of six struggles to rebuild her life and find love again. But when a new man suddenly sweeps her off her feet, how far will she go to guarantee that her second chance at love doesn't slip away?

episodes.name: Fatal Error
episodes.summary: A young mother falls for a dangerous man who leads her down a path of deception and violence. When he's accused of murder, she must choose: turn in the man she loves or risk everything to protect him as the police close in on them both.

episodes.name: The Last Ride
episodes.summary: Telisha Williams falls for Javonta Williams, but love turns risky when she lies to cover his tracks. As their story unravels and the truth begins to surface, her false alibi drags her into a storm of consequences she never saw coming.

episodes.name: Blind Trust
episodes.summary: A young woman falls in love and builds a life with a much older man, until their marriage takes a toxic turn. As pressure builds within their relationship, she must make a life-changing decision: escape or join his misguided revenge plot.

episodes.name: Crushed by Love
episodes.summary: Blinded by jealousy, Shareyll Hunter slams her ex's pregnant girlfriend with a stolen car, tearing apart three lives in a desperate fight to reclaim her place in his heart. But when love turns lethal, who really wins?

episodes.name: The Perils of Passion
episodes.summary: A driven young woman falls for an older man and thinks she has found a partner she can start a family with. When a romantic rival threatens her dream, devastation turns to rage, and her future takes a dark turn she never sees coming.

episodes.name: Opposites Attract
episodes.summary: An ambitious single mother with a bright future finds love in a man with a troubled past. When he is linked to murder, she stands by him. And as evidence mounts, loyalty turns to liability and she faces harsh truth: love costs everything.

episodes.name: Stolen Innocence
episodes.summary: When a bright young woman with career aspirations falls for a bad boy, he takes her for a walk on the wild side. He lands them both in hot water and she must choose between the future she thought she wanted, and a future with her man.

episodes.name: Bait and Switch
episodes.summary: Driven by desperation, a young mother risks it all for happiness. But when her past and present collide in a terrifying night of violence, questions mount about what really happened, and how far a person might go for the ones they love.

episodes.name: S9.EP26 Martesha Johnson
episodes.summary: Jasmine Webb's romance began in light but ended in darkness. Manipulated by abuse and drugs, she became trapped in a violent spiral—until one night at a barbecue, gunfire claimed an innocent man and shattered families forever.

episodes.name: Lawless Love
episodes.summary: A seasoned correctional officer finds herself drawn to the kind of man she's spent her career keeping the city safe from. And as the relationship quickly heats up, she must choose between the life she's known and this new found love.

episodes.name: Flames of Passion
episodes.summary: A Woman is out to get her man back and is burning with so much passion that she accidentally kills two innocent men trying to get their lives together in a boarding home. Edward Hughs is caught up in a fire set by a jealous woman's fury as he and his friend James are trapped by their own senseless doom.

episodes.name: Double Trouble
episodes.summary: A married mother sought escape in Chicago's nightlife, caught between two men – one offering stability, the other passion. But how long can a double life stay hidden? Beneath the glittering lights, a sinister tale of betrayal brewing.

episodes.name: Annette Morales-Rodrigues
episodes.summary: A woman, Annette Morales-Rodrigues, tries to get pregnant to have a baby for her boyfriend who desperately wants one. When she can't, she kills a woman and attempts to take her unborn child from her womb.

episodes.name: Love Weaponized
episodes.summary: A teenage girl, ensnared by the allure of an older man, becomes entangled in a perilous web of deceit. From her loyalty comes a deadly setup culminating in a tragic murder that leaves her future hanging in the balance.

episodes.name: Silenced Ambition
episodes.summary: She had it all—beauty, success, and a love that felt unbreakable. When a tempting offer promises effortless riches, she can't resist. Her choice leads to deadly consequences, unraveling her life and exposing the danger of blind love.

episodes.name: Matched for Murder
episodes.summary: A young woman trying to turn her life around falls for a smooth-talking ex-con. After crossing state lines for him, she's pulled into a world of his secrets and criminal deception. Now, she must ask herself—how far is too far for love?

episodes.name: Stolen Future
episodes.summary: A 19-year-old falls hard for a reckless man who has a gun, a plan, and no conscience. Her soft heart gives way to blind loyalty—landing her behind the wheel of a deadly crime spree with no escape route.

episodes.name: Irreconcilable Differences
episodes.summary: After years of separation, a wife's hope to reconcile with her husband is shattered when he falls for a younger woman. A confrontation to win her man back spirals out of control, leaving one dead and the other on the run.

episodes.name: The Cost of Forever
episodes.summary: Loyalty to the love of her life and the father of her child is all this young mother has ever known. When passion turns a blind eye to the truth, she's forced to make an impossible choice: stand by him or save herself.

episodes.name: Banking On Love
episodes.summary: A woman's life quickly unravels when she loses her job. Seeking comfort, she falls for a charming criminal. As their bond deepens, so does the danger, leading her into a string of bank robberies and behind the wheel of the getaway car.

episodes.name: The Wrong Woman
episodes.summary: A young couple from Puerto Rico moves to Florida to start a new life together, but in their pursuit of happily ever after, did they unknowingly strike a deal with the devil? A kidnapping unravels and tests their devotion.

episodes.name: Love and Larceny
episodes.summary: A mother who's ready to settle down finds love in a man with a checkered past. He pulls her into one of his high-stake schemes, and she must decide whether to go along for the ride or do what she knows is right.

episodes.name: Blood Money
episodes.summary: A deadly plot unfolds as love and desperation collide in Detroit. Amber Hunter and her beau, Javontae Wakefield, are driven to a gruesome act against her own mother, Tiffany Hunter, in a harrowing quest for cash.

episodes.name: Vendetta
episodes.summary: In Suffolk County, a romantic entanglement spirals into a sinister trap. Dequanna Bates and Joshua Nickens' vendetta against Alan Moore leads to deadly consequences, as love blinds and dark intentions take over.

episodes.name: Club Jealousy
episodes.summary: A flirtatious comment at a club turns deadly. Gina Conway and rapper boyfriend Max B's love story twists into a grim plot, culminating in tragedy over jealousy and betrayal.

episodes.name: Vengeance in Louisville
episodes.summary: Love and loss drive Cheetara Goldsmith to a devastating act of vengeance. In Louisville, a tale of heartbreak transforms into a dark pursuit of retribution.

episodes.name: Betrayal Bound
episodes.summary: In Dearborn, Patricia Jernigan, entangled in her boyfriend's schemes, targets a childhood friend in a harrowing plot. Depths of betrayal and coercion are revealed.

episodes.name: Loyalty's Price
episodes.summary: Chicago's gritty hip-hop scene sets the stage for Breanna Patterson's deep loyalty to Charles Smith. Their twisted love leads to a disastrous home invasion, changing lives forever.

episodes.name: Family Deception
episodes.summary: A chilling family betrayal unfolds as Terica Ellis aids her lover Tim Norman in a dark web of deception and greed in St. Louis, proving fatal for a close relative.

episodes.name: Deadly Triangle
episodes.summary: Jealousy and a fraught love triangle lead to irreversible loss in Detroit. Gabrielle Brantley's toxic blend of love and betrayal ends in tragedy for an aspiring nurse.

episodes.name: Love's Lethal Lies
episodes.summary: In South Bend, Tiaira Miller's bid to protect her man embroils her in deceit. Her tangled web of lies and hidden evidence leads to a tragic unraveling.

episodes.name: Loyalty's Deadly Price
episodes.summary: In La Crosse, Brittany Jones' rush to aid her boyfriend after a violent encounter plunges her into a legal nightmare, with loyalty leading to harsh consequences.

episodes.name: Fatal Jealousy
episodes.summary: A manipulative love triangle turns deadly in Las Vegas. Shamiya Todd's jealousy, influenced by her ex-husband's deceit, leads to dire consequences.

episodes.name: Silencing for Love
episodes.summary: Brianna Smith's love for Romando Williams leads her into a deadly plot to silence a rival. Blinded by her devotion, she helps Romando carry out a fatal plan, but the price of loyalty is too high. Will Brianna's love cost her everything?

episodes.name: Lured by Loyalty
episodes.summary: Terreona Horton's love for Lydell Sparks leads her to participate in a fatal ambush. Blinded by her loyalty, she lures an innocent man into a trap, sealing her fate. Can love push her to make the ultimate sacrifice?

episodes.name: Deadly Demands
episodes.summary: Daja Giles's love for Kalius Lane drags her into a deadly confrontation. When jealousy leads to murder, Daja is forced to choose between her loyalty and her future. Can she escape the destructive cycle of love and betrayal?

episodes.name: Fatal Devotion
episodes.summary: Zuri London's devotion to a man on trial for murder pushes her to extreme lengths. She helps him flee from justice, thinking love will protect them. But can Zuri's loyalty save her, or will it ultimately lead to her downfall?

episodes.name: Ride or Die Sacrifice
episodes.summary: Melissa Rios Roque's love for Kelsey McFoley drags her into a deadly scheme. To protect him from prison, Melissa helps orchestrate a murder-for-hire plot. How far will her love push her before everything comes crashing down?

episodes.name: Deadly Devotion
episodes.summary:
Storyline: Summer of 2009 - Jasmine helps her man carry out the murder of his rival, putting her bright future on hold.

Jasmine Rivera seemed like an ordinary teenager from Scranton, Pennsylvania. She played sports, attended school, and had dreams like many other girls her age. But underneath the surface, Jasmine's life was far more complicated. From a young age, she sought love and belonging, something she never truly found in her broken family life. By the time she was 17, Jasmine had already become a mother and was living with her boyfriend, Tonie Future, in a small apartment in the projects. What started as a teenage romance soon turned into a life of crime, as Jasmine found herself ensnared in the world of the notorious Bloods street gang. Tonie Future, Jasmine's high school sweetheart and father to her child, had recently fallen under the influence of his older brother, Jeff Future, a high-ranking member of the Bloods. While Jasmine had reservations about the lifestyle Tonie was falling into, her love for him-and the makeshift family they had built-kept her from leaving. As their relationship deepened, Jasmine found herself drawn into criminal activities, participating in robberies and burglaries, all in an effort to prove her loyalty to Tonie and the gang.

On July 30, 2009, the gang's violent underworld caught up with them in the most tragic way. That night, a group of women driving on a remote road outside Scranton discovered a body lying in the middle of the street. They immediately called the police, but what was first reported as a hit-and-run soon turned into a murder investigation. The victim, 29-year-old Allen Fernandez, had been shot 12 times at close range in what police would later describe as a professional hit. As detectives began piecing together the evidence, they discovered that Fernandez, a former Bloods gang member, had recently been released from a halfway house in Hazleton, PA, where he had been trying to distance himself from his criminal past. His family believed he had left the gang life behind, but the circumstances of his death suggested otherwise. The number of gunshot wounds, combined with the shell casings found at the scene from both a .40 caliber and 9mm weapon, indicated multiple shooters-and pointed to a gang-related execution. The investigation took a significant turn when detectives uncovered cellphone records linking Fernandez to a number belonging to Barbara Future, the mother of Jeff and Tonie. With this connection, investigators began to focus on the Future brothers, and Jasmine soon became a key figure in their web of criminal activity. Surveillance footage and interviews with residents of

the halfway house revealed that Fernandez had purchased a burner phone just hours before his murder and had received several calls from Barbara Future's phone. It became clear that the brothers had lured Fernandez to Scranton, where they ambushed him. Despite their efforts to cover their tracks, the pressure mounted on Jasmine, Tonie, and Jeff as police began closing in on them. Under interrogation, Jasmine confessed to her role in a series of other crimes, including the robbery of a Dunkin Donuts and the burglary of a Pennsylvania State Trooper's home, where a .40 caliber Beretta service weapon had been stolen. That same weapon was later used in the murder of Allen Fernandez. Jasmine's devotion to Tonie and her involvement in these crimes stemmed from a misguided sense of loyalty and love. She had been willing to do anything to support Tonie, even if it meant participating in violent acts that would ultimately destroy her life. In the end, Jasmine's testimony helped prosecutors secure convictions against both Jeff and Tonie Future for first-degree murder, and Christian Kenyon, another accomplice, for his role in the crime. Jasmine herself was sentenced to prison for her part in the burglary and robbery.

For Allen Fernandez's family, the loss was devastating. He had been trying to turn his life around, only to be brutally murdered by the very people he had once been associated with. For Jasmine, the cost of her loyalty to Tonie Future was high. She lost her freedom, her future, and any chance of a normal life, all because of her love for a man who led her down a dangerous path.

episodes.summary: After the team unearths new and bizarre clues from the Mesa on Skinwalker Ranch, a complex laser experiment leads to a shocking encounter.
