episodes.name: Shed Happens
episodes.summary: In Minneapolis, a dispute over a pear tree takes a shocking turn when one neighbor pulls out a weapon; in Illinois, a woman washing her car faces off with her neighbor after water splashes on her driveway.

episodes.name: Hook, Line and Sinker
episodes.summary: In New Jersey, an angry neighbor accosts two young fishermen who are trespassing on his riverbank; a Texas man provokes a family with vulgar taunts at all hours of the day and night.

episodes.name: Snack Attack
episodes.summary: A Missouri landlord torments his tenants, a Georgia porch pirate is caught hiding in a sewer drain, and California parents go to war at a kid's soccer game.

episodes.name: When Neighbors Snap
episodes.summary: Women go crazy at a neighborhood pool, a man threatens kids fishing in a pond, a tourist attacked by a homeless man in San Francisco is helped by two naked men, a property line dispute escalates when a new fence is about to go up.

episodes.name: Who Are You, the Mermaid Patrol?
episodes.summary: In Jupiter, Florida an animal activist confronts a family she thinks is swimming near manatees, accusing them of putting wildlife at risk; In England, a man's chats with a mutual neighbor spark a drama with the woman next door.

episodes.name: Mother's Worst Nightmare
episodes.summary: A woman freaks out over kids playing in a park; an HOA board member on a serious power trip; a man can't tolerate a neighbor walking his dog; a man with a loaded shotgun breaks into his neighbor's house; a delivery driver is accosted.

episodes.name: Predator on the Porch
episodes.summary: Florida property managers torment an older resident; fishing with permission outrages a woman; a British neighbor's boyfriend offer to repair a damaged fence turns into a ripoff; a pizza delivery driver confronts an alligator.

episodes.name: Battle for the Block
episodes.summary: Florida man knocks over a kid riding his bicycle; California HOA board members torment a tenant; a South Carolina father-son argument enrages a neighbor; a woman in Florida is outraged at children riding their bikes.

episodes.name: Planks for Nothing
episodes.summary: In California, a routine house move turns tense when one neighbor pushes back on cul-de-sac access; In Florida, a homeowner replacing a rotting fence is met with an unusual demand to return the old boards.

episodes.name: Fence and Sensibity
episodes.summary: In Dayton, Ohio, tensions between two families boil over as both sides accuse the other's children of bullying; in Alabama, an off-duty police officer is struck by a neighbor furious over loud music.

episodes.name: Move It or Else
episodes.summary: In Florida, a man's refusal to move his van from the middle of the road quickly lands him in handcuffs; in Pennsylvania, a Halloween party takes a terrifying turn when an angry young man crashes through the front door.

episodes.name: No-Fly Zone
episodes.summary: In Oregon, a family is stunned to learn they've been living next door to a wanted felon; on a California beach, a man flying a remote-controlled plane clashes with a neighbor.

episodes.name: Mailbox Mayhem
episodes.summary: In Fond du Lac, Wisconsin, a parking dispute escalates on the day a man is expecting an important delivery; in Pennsylvania, a landlord and tenant clash after a mailbox is replaced without permission.

episodes.name: Space Invaders
episodes.summary: In Michigan, a dispute over shared driveway parking; in Ohio, a simple mail mix-up sparks an outsized reaction; and in Chicago, a routine move-out inspection turns into a heated showdown between renters and their landlord.

episodes.name: Toxic Tensions
episodes.summary: In Tennessee, a wrong-way confrontation at an apartment complex erupts into a shouting standoff with a surprising end; In South Bend, Ind.,a long-running feud over dogs, trash and surveillance turns toxic.

episodes.name: Spray of Fury
episodes.summary: In California, a man threatens a couple with pepper spray over their dog's behavior; in Georgia, a construction crew faces off with a neighbor determined to shut them down.

episodes.name: Open Door, Big Mistake
episodes.summary: In Chesterfield, Virginia, a downstairs neighbor confrontation over moving noise quickly escalates; a Florida family is shocked when their doorbell camera captures a neighbor entering their home uninvited.

episodes.name: Mind Your Business
episodes.summary: In Portland, Oregon, a man standing in his own driveway is questioned by a neighbor about why he's there; in South Carolina's Blue Ridge Mountains, a tense balcony dispute escalates when a husband steps in to defend his family.

episodes.name: Caught and Confronted
episodes.summary: An Oklahoma woman loses her cool after accusing neighbors of letting their dog do its business right outside her patio; a Michigan family is shocked when a neighbor shows up at their front door with a loaded handgun.

episodes.name: Badge of Chaos
episodes.summary: In Florida, neighbors call the police on a man who is blasting loud music and scattering household items in the street; construction workers in Georgia clash with a neighbor who accuses them of shoddy work.

episodes.name: Get Your Junk Outta Here
episodes.summary: A woman and her sisters are moving in when a new neighbour takes issue with their discarded furniture; a package delivery triggers a full-on raid; a peaceful day at the boat dock erupts when an angry man threatens a neighbour with a "toothpick."

episodes.name: Neighborhood Wars Top 10: Beyond the Limit
It's Time to Party!
episodes.summary: With less than 7 months to their big day, Baylen and Colin are still struggling to make major wedding decisions. Baylen and maid of honor Sammi are at odds over the planning of Baylen and Colin's joint bachelor/bachelorette weekend.

episodes.name: Altared Plans
episodes.summary: Sammi misses their joint Bach weekend. Baylen confronts her about her role. Julie worries about the venue's remote location, prompting Baylen to suggest a plan that could risk the entire wedding day.

episodes.name: Unsave the Date
episodes.summary: Baylen's tics flare up during Christmas photos with Santa, Colin, and their dogs. Allen prepares a surprise for his 25th anniversary with Julie. Baylen and Colin announce an important wedding choice.

episodes.name: Say Yes to the Stress
episodes.summary: Baylen and Colin's engagement sparks wedding preparations. Baylen travels to Florida with her mom and grandmothers to shop for her dream wedding gown. Allen gets life-changing news that may relocate the family.

episodes.name: Knot on My Bingo Card
episodes.summary: Baylen struggles to choose from too many wedding dresses. A girls' weekend in Kansas with Julie and Sammi pushes Baylen beyond her comfort zone.

episodes.name: 'Til Death Do Us Part
episodes.summary: Sammi's surprises prompt Baylen and Julie to make lasting choices and visit a funeral home. Later, differing views on wedding plans cause tension between the sisters.

episodes.name: Roses Are Red, Officiants Are Bald
episodes.summary: Baylen returns from Kansas City hurt by Sammi's comment. Colin plans a Valentine's surprise and they meet a wedding officiant, but he reveals an unexpected bombshell. Meanwhile, Bechnir reluctantly goes tux shopping.

episodes.name: A Tasting of Things to Come
episodes.summary: After surprising Baylen with wedding changes, Colin drops another bombshell at their menu tasting. Meanwhile, Julie fears the mounting pressure on Sammi to deliver a perfect celebration may damage her fragile relationship with Baylen.

episodes.name: Showered with Opinions
episodes.summary: Baylen's bridal shower finally arrives, but the celebration takes a turn when she reveals shocking future plans. Later, Baylen and Sammi confront the tension that's been lingering.

episodes.name: To Have and To Hold...A Mortgage
episodes.summary: Baylen and Colin travel to Myrtle Beach to explore relocation, but Baylen navigates the trip without her medication.

episodes.name: This Is Our Reality
episodes.summary: Baylen Dupree refuses to let Tourette Syndrome define her life.

episodes.name: Obsessed with Everything
episodes.summary: Baylen and Colin enjoy their engagement but delay wedding plans. Baylen confronts Allen over an issue. She reluctantly bakes Colin's birthday cake. Her parents make an unexpected request.

episodes.name: The Ticcer
episodes.summary: Baylen reacts surprisingly at their first wedding venue visit. She sees her CBIT therapist about wedding day goals. During pre-marital counseling, Colin discloses a hidden secret.

episodes.name: Addicted All Around
episodes.summary: Colin's revelation disrupts wedding plans. Sammi and Burke voice their thoughts to Baylen as Allen develops a scheme he hopes she'll approve for her wedding.

episodes.name: Anxiety on High Alert
episodes.summary: Baylen hosts a sleepover for her brother, Bechnir. Allen and Julie seize the rare chance to have a date night. Bechnir confides in Baylen about his severe anxiety. Allen confronts the painful history behind his fierce protectiveness.

episodes.name: It's So Inappropriate!
episodes.summary: Baylen's tic about Colin's mom affects their Roanoke plans. Colin seeks career guidance from his sister post-military. Julie and Allen talk about Bechnir's anxiety. Colin brings unexpected guests to tour a venue.

episodes.name: She's Gonna Lose Her Mind
episodes.summary: The therapist disrupts Colin's plan to confront Allen. After finding their dream venue, Baylen and Colin reconsider their choices when seeing the decorated Dupree backyard.

episodes.name: Did I Mention That I Have Tourette?
episodes.summary: At their engagement party, Baylen and Colin finally announce they've chosen the wedding venue of their dreams but it's a decision that leaves both Julie and Allen struggling to find their place in Baylen's wedding plans.

episodes.name: Saddle Up!
episodes.summary: Baylen and Colin's plan to set boundaries turns upside down when Allen pressures Colin to have a back-up plan for his new real estate career. The couple gets a harsh reality check at their first meeting with their wedding planner.

episodes.name: I'm on the Struggle Bus
episodes.summary: Baylen and Colin find themselves in an impossible situation with the wedding. Baylen readies herself for wedding dress shopping, but it's bittersweet without Sammi. On their drive to meet Dr. Flaherty, Colin drops a truth bomb on Baylen.

episodes.name: Get Me Out of Here!
episodes.summary: Baylen discovers a tic-management device requiring international travel; her library visit becomes chaotic; Colin faces early challenges while pursuing his new professional path.

episodes.name: Your Anxiety Is Giving Me Anxiety
episodes.summary: The Duprees head to London where Baylen may test a device to help with her tics, but airport challenges and Colin's flight anxiety complicate their travel.

episodes.name: Ticcing in a British Accent
episodes.summary: The Dupree's arrive in London. And they must quickly navigate the culture shock. On a double-decker tour bus, Baylen becomes overstimulated, and her tics escalate, causing her a lot of distress.

episodes.name: My Brain Feels Different
episodes.summary: After battling worsening tics in London, Baylen tests a device that may reduce them and transform her life. Baylen and Colin rethink their plans, shocking Allen and Julie.

episodes.name: Tasting Out Loud
episodes.summary: Baylen and Colin take on D.C. and taste some of the city's best cuisines in hope of finding inspiration for their wedding.

episodes.name: Vanished in the Heartland
episodes.summary: Questions and accusations fly after savvy entrepreneur and mother of five 52 year old Dee Warner vanishes from her rural Michigan home. Authorities struggle for answers until they find her closer to home than anyone could've imagined.

episodes.name: Death in Hell's Kitchen
episodes.summary: Pride month kicks off in 2022, the deaths of two gay men in NYC shatter their families and the gay community, leading the NYPD to uncover a ruthless gang that stalks, drugs, and murders their victims before draining their bank accounts.

episodes.name: Sex House Homicide
episodes.summary: In Ocala, Florida, the local sheriff's office responds to a wellness check only to find the body of a man in what looks like a sexual pleasure palace. Could it be a homosexual hate crime, revenge, or is the killer much closer to home?

episodes.name: Playing with Fire
episodes.summary: Chronicles a 2001 Florida case where a father is killed and his home set ablaze, with his sons missing, and how investigators followed leads to unravel the truth

episodes.name: The Serial Killer Who Only Killed Once
episodes.summary: A killer savagely slays Robin Lawrence at home while her child is asleep. An investigation circles her husband, until a drop of blood unlocks the mystery of Robin's murder and leads to a shocking confession.

episodes.name: Looking for Angela
episodes.summary: A reclusive Kansas mother vanishes in 2019. Her teenage daughter and police search for answers but face deception everywhere. With no online presence or friends who know her, clues quickly disappear.

episodes.name: The Girl On The Bike
episodes.summary: In 1972, 20-year-old Jody Loomis takes a late afternoon bike ride to visit her horse. Later that day, she is found murdered in the woods. For decades, everyone in the small town of Bothell, Washington is a suspect for local authorities.

episodes.name: The Final Cut
episodes.summary: Celebrity hairstylist Fabio Sementilli's teenage daughter discovers him brutally murdered on their Los Angeles patio. The LAPD uncovers a shocking story of lust, betrayal, and greed that turns the glamorous world of beauty upside down.

episodes.name: The Secrets of the 12 Tribes Cult
episodes.summary: Gene Spriggs forms the Twelve Tribes in Tennessee with teens and disenchanted hippies; the group later gains a cult reputation and faces accusations of child abuse, forced labor, and strict devotion to what members say is God's will.

episodes.name: Love, Lies, And Lust
episodes.summary: Outside of Orlando, life is no longer a fairytale for childhood sweethearts Mike and Laurie Shaver. Fighting and infidelity lead to broken dreams. When police search their backyard in 2018, what they find scars the family.

episodes.name: Deadly Ride
episodes.summary: In 2022, Austin police find 25-year-old cyclist Mo Wilson shot execution-style while visiting a friend. Detectives uncover a chilling story of jealousy, betrayal, and obsession.

episodes.name: The Truth About Blair
episodes.summary: Jennifer Brown, vanishes from her Limerick home and detectives race against the clock to find her. With her eight- year-old son asking where his mother is, investigators must confront a web of lies woven by the people she trusts the most.

episodes.name: Where is Judith?
episodes.summary: A home intruder kidnaps a 60-year-old woman overnight. As sheriffs search, a second similar attack emerges ten miles away, raising fears a serial predator is stalking Florida's Gulf Coast.

episodes.name: The Boogeyman
episodes.summary: The Lunsford family's lives turn upside down when someone snatches nine-year old Jessie from her bed. Authorities scour the area looking for her when they discover a dark truth, she is closer than they ever realized.

episodes.name: A Story to Die for
episodes.summary: Virginia firefighters respond to a house fire in Upperville where they discover the body of a local journalist who has been shot two times. The victim's social media history leads police down a rabbit hole.

episodes.name: Sex. Clowns. Murder.
episodes.summary: Florida: In 1990, a clown delivering flowers and balloons guns down Marlene Warren at her home. With scant evidence and no clear motive, detectives set out to track down the killer clown, but the culprit eludes justice for thirty years before being fully unmasked and convicted of murder.

episodes.name: The Serial Killers Playbook

episodes.name: The Aloha Murder

episodes.name: Teenage Assassins

episodes.name: Gate Clash
episodes.summary: At a hotel in Georgia, a guest causes a scene while demanding staff remove his visitor. At a Florida airport, police are called over a suspected confrontation involving two sisters and a gate agent on the jet bridge.

episodes.name: Last Call
episodes.summary: In a Tampa, Florida discount store, a heated argument erupts between a customer, another patron, and staff, as employees struggle to stay composed in the face of escalating tension. In Hyannis, Massachusetts, a restaurant's closing time leads to chaos.

episodes.name: Guard Down
episodes.summary: In a restaurant in Georgia, a mother confronts a male customer who she claims complained about her child's volume. At a Florida bar, an allegedly intoxicated woman who is being escorted out by police answers a call from her dad.

episodes.name: Check Please
episodes.summary: At a fast food restaurant in Florissant, Missouri, tensions rise when the husband of a customer accused of a bad parking job confronts her accuser.

episodes.name: Flightless and Furious
episodes.summary: In Maryland, a delivery worker's sharp turn catches his co-worker off guard. At the Tampa airport, a passenger who's upset at missing her flight is confronted by police.

episodes.name: Game Over
episodes.summary: At an amusement park in Florida, police officers confront a couple causing a disturbance. Inside a Wisconsin convenience store, a dissatisfied customer takes her frustration out on merchandise.

episodes.name: High Stakes Heist
episodes.summary: On an airplane in Los Angeles, two friends are confronted by the flight crew for wearing crop tops. In Atlanta, Georgia, police are called to a store to deal with two suspected shoplifters.

episodes.name: Iced Out
episodes.summary: On a train in New York City, a woman becomes upset after hearing a group of tourists speak in their native language. In Key West, Florida, police intervene at a local bar where two men get into a confrontation with another customer.

episodes.name: Fired Up
episodes.summary: In Orlando, Florida, a tense standoff unfolds in a convenience store when an officer finds a delivery driver being restrained by an employee.

episodes.name: Don't Look Up
episodes.summary: At a restaurant in Texas, a melee erupts after a patron is allegedly served the wrong type of salsa. Inside a Michigan gas station, a dispute over the price of soda becomes dangerously heated.

episodes.name: Room Ragers
episodes.summary: At a baseball game, a confrontation between an employee and two fans over alleged rude behavior turns into a physical altercation.

episodes.name: Clocked Out
episodes.summary: At a Florida fast food restaurant, police intervene as a terminated employee seems to refuse to vacate the property. On a New York flight, a former pro fighter ends up being removed after allegedly becoming aggressive over a baggage issue.

episodes.name: Trespass Trouble
episodes.summary: In Oakland, California, a customer holding up the line sparks an offensive verbal blowup with other customers. In Newport, Rhode Island, a public official and her friend resist as police attempt to remove them from a bar.

episodes.name: Commuter Combat
episodes.summary: At a Kansas fast-food restaurant, a worker who complimented a female customer at the drive-through is confronted by her angry husband. On the subway in New York, a verbal dispute between two riders quickly turns violent; and more.

episodes.name: Birthday Blowup
episodes.summary: A checkout line mess sparks a confrontation between customers.

episodes.name: Camp Confrontation
episodes.summary: At an Oregon summer camp, an employee confronts a delivery driver, and simple questions quickly turn into a heated clash. On the Los Angeles Metro, a mysterious argument between two riders erupts into a physical brawl.

episodes.name: Noise Nonsense
episodes.summary: In Chappell Hill, Texas, a fast food employee is confronted after a customer believes he was commenting on her weight. In Joliet, Illinois, an early-morning noise complaint at a gym escalates into a clash with police; and more.

episodes.name: Pizza Police
episodes.summary: In a Florida neighborhood, police answering a call about an alligator loose in a neighborhood intercept a woman trying to deliver pizza to a customer.

episodes.name: Supermarket Showdown
episodes.summary: In California, a customer confronts her food delivery driver after an issue with her order. In Flagler Beach, Florida, a belligerent bar patron squanders multiple opportunities to avoid arrest.

episodes.name: Exit Denied
episodes.summary: At a Texas superstore, a customer gets irate after an employee asks to check her receipt before she leaves. In Florida, a man allegedly attacks a couple in a restaurant - and a server who joins the brawl may know more than she admits.

episodes.name: Turning Tables
episodes.summary: On a flight in Florida, passengers turn on a woman who rushes to the front of the line waiting to deboard. In Punta Gorda, Florida, a fishing dispute explodes when an enraged captain boards another boater's vessel.

episodes.name: '57 Chevy Two-Day Turnaround!
episodes.summary: If transforming a car in two days sounds tough, try doing it in a parking lot. The guys take Dave's blown, big-block '57 Bel Air to compete in the autocross at Cruisin' the Coast in Mississippi. With a complete overhaul of the suspension in the event's parking lot, the guys find out how much lap time they can shave with a weekend's worth of work.

episodes.name: V-8 Baja Bug Suspension Overhaul!
episodes.summary: Off-road legend Cameron Steele warned the guys that a V-8 swap wouldn't cut as much time as a long-travel suspension could, and they didn't listen. Now Newbern and Cotten are finally heeding his advice and going all out with major suspension upgrades to their Baja-inspired VW Beetle. But when they return to the desert, a huge surprise is revealed that changes everything.

episodes.name: Drag Racing Model A!
episodes.summary: Can a stock Model A become a true hot rod and dragstrip contender? The guys take on top fuel driver Clay Millican by totally transforming a Model A from the ground up. With a new chassis, suspension and fresh 347ci V-8 with 400 hp, this Ford vastly improves in every way possible.

episodes.name: Turbocharged Eagle Rally Racer!
episodes.summary: It's not an import...rally? Thus time on Faster With Newbern and Cotten, the guys discover a gem that's not your typical American muscle with a turbocharged Eagle Talon. Yes, it looks like an import, but don't be fooled. This thing rips. Shea Seefeldt from Runs Good challenges the guys on a rally course with his LS-swapped Subaru, and the guys take the Talon from street to dirt.

episodes.name: Monte Carlo Circle Track Surprise!
episodes.summary: There's nothing better than a friend surprising you with one of your favorite cars. This time on Faster with Newbern and Cotten, Newbern surprises Cotten with a mint 1984 G-Body and an '80s style stock car inspired build to take on an actual former cup car around the circle track. Will their suspension and engine upgrades over a few days be enough to cut it?

episodes.name: Pro Street Mirada Makeover!
episodes.summary: Pro Street is back. This time on Faster with Newbern and Cotten, the guys go back to a time when looking good was as good as going fast. It's a revival for Cotten's Pro Street big-block 1980 Dodge Mirada whose engine died on Roadkill. However, things don't go as planned as the guys attempt to add a giant blower, bigger tires, and bring the car back to the 1990s-era glory it once had.

episodes.summary: The final three go to battle against each other for the power to cast the last eviction vote of the season and the jury returns to pick a winner. Also before the night is through the Mastermind will finally be unmasked.

episodes.name: Auditions Day 1 (Europe)
episodes.summary: GLOBAL GAUNTLET - Eight home cooks kick off the audition rounds inspired by Europe, as flavors and traditions from across the continent take center stage.

episodes.name: Auditions Day 2 (Asia-Pacific)
episodes.summary: Eight home cooks compete to represent their heritage from the Asia-Pacific region in the audition battles.

episodes.name: Auditions Day 3 (Africa)
episodes.summary: Eight more home cooks compete to represent their heritage from the African region in the audition battles.

episodes.name: Auditions Day 4 (The Americas)
episodes.summary: The final audition round features home cooks from the Americas competing for white aprons. Tonight's auditions showcase bold personalities and unique dishes. Just five will earn white aprons and the chance to represent the Americas.

episodes.name: Game Day Gourmet
episodes.summary: Twenty exceptional home cooks from auditions, five per region, compete in a World Cup-themed challenge to craft upscale versions of stadium classics with their cultural influences.

episodes.name: Eggs Benedict
episodes.summary: Home cooks discover mystery boxes filled only with eggs at their stations. Each contestant must showcase their culture by preparing a distinctive version of the classic Eggs Benedict.

episodes.name: Team Pitch to Plate
episodes.summary: Chefs compete in their first team challenge for the starting lineup. They partner with U.S. Soccer Federation to serve lunch to 101 kids from the field. With a guest judge and Gordon Ramsay as goalkeeper, one team wins immunity.

episodes.name: World Cup Cookoff
episodes.summary: The MasterChef kitchen becomes a backyard BBQ where home cooks swap aprons for jerseys and elevate their country's game day favorites. This challenge celebrates family, culture, and pride with higher stakes than ever.

episodes.name: Bitter Sweet Mystery Box
episodes.summary: Tonight, using their second Mystery Box of the season, the Top Sixteen home cooks create chocolate confections inspired by their heritage. With a double-elimination looming, the competition has never been sweeter or more intense.

episodes.name: Wheel of Fusion
episodes.summary: Tonight, the Top 14 home cooks face the Wheel of Fusion challenge. After spinning the wheel, each contestant is assigned a global cuisine that they must blend with the flavors and traditions of their own heritage. Pushed to showcase creativity and adaptability, the cooks must work with unfamiliar ingredients and techniques to create a successful fusion dish. As the judges sample their way around the world, only one team will come out on top and earn an immunity pin.

episodes.name: Royal Wedding
episodes.summary: The Top 12 home cooks head to a grand castle to cater the MasterChef Royal Wedding of Season 15 winners Jesse and Jessica. With 50 guests deciding their fate, the teams must deliver a feast worthy of the crown. In the end, not every fairy tale gets a happy ending as one team finds themselves at risk of elimination.

episodes.name: Global Feed
episodes.summary: Celebrity chef, social media icon, and past MasterChef contestant Nick DiGiovanni joins as a special guest to test the chefs' ability to turn their cultural roots into the next viral food sensation. With an exciting collaboration opportunity with DiGiovanni on the line, the contestants must strike the perfect balance between authenticity and social media appeal.

episodes.name: The Audition Battles
episodes.summary: Eight pairs of home cooks go head-to-head fighting to win legendary white aprons

episodes.name: The Audition Battles Continue
episodes.summary: The remaining eight pairs of home cooks go head-to-head in the audition battles for a chance to win coveted white aprons.

episodes.name: Second Chance Battles
episodes.summary: The duos who failed to get white aprons in the audition rounds get a surprise second chance; four duos redeem themselves and join the top eight white apron winners, securing a prized place in the top 12.

episodes.name: Dinner Party Dish
episodes.summary: Twelve talented cooking pairs compete to create the ultimate dinner party masterpiece, putting their combined culinary skills to the test as they vie for the judges' approval.

episodes.name: Mister-y & Mrs. Box
episodes.summary: In the first Mystery Box challenge of the season, the Top 11 duos must combine two boxes of ingredients to make a harmonious dish.

episodes.name: Pier Pressure
episodes.summary: The Top 10 duos, in a stunning pier-side setting, are tasked with feeding over 100 local fishermen and women; the worst performing team faces the dreaded pressure test.

episodes.name: Mystery Box
episodes.summary: The five duos on the losing team from the previous challenge face the first pressure test of the season: a dessert mystery box challenge.

episodes.name: Recipe Telephone
episodes.summary: Each duo is split up, and one teammate begins cooking, but the second teammate must complete the dish.

episodes.name: Train to Table
episodes.summary: Two teams must prepare a VIP dining experience aboard a moving steam train.

episodes.name: The Great Ingredient Bid Off
episodes.summary: The four duos on the losing team last week fight for survival in a new pressure test challenge; the duos must bid for their ingredients, but they must give up time instead of money to get their preferred ingredients.

episodes.name: Macaron Mayhem
episodes.summary: The duos must bake not just a dozen macarons, but a giant tower of perfectly formed delicacies.

episodes.name: Backyard BBQ
episodes.summary: The MasterChef garden is decked out for a sunny backyard BBQ and the Top 6 duos feel the burn. Split into two teams, they must serve a garden full of BBQ aficionados. The losing team will go straight into a pressure test, where one couple will be eliminated.

episodes.name: Divide & Conquer
episodes.summary: Three duos from last week's losing team compete in season's final Pressure Test, recreating signature dishes from restaurants of judges Joe Bastianich, Tiffany Derry, and Gordon Ramsay.

episodes.name: The Wall
episodes.summary: Both cooks in each duo must make the exact same dish while divided by an eight-foot-high wall, communicating by shouting over it; the duos must ensure their dish looks and tastes the same; the pair who make the worst dish are eliminated.

episodes.name: Grand Finale, Part 1
episodes.summary: The top 3 pairs cook their final, most daunting night in the MasterChef kitchen for the Grand Finale. Friends, family watch as judges scrutinize them - teams must deliver peak performance together.

episodes.name: You Can't Sip with Us
episodes.summary: Danny and Nia manage four kids. Kristen and Luke clash as new parents. Brittany pursues a new romance while Zack fears it's too quick. At Kristen and Nia's Sip and See, Michelle stresses when Jesse's girlfriend Lacy arrives unexpectedly.

episodes.name: Snip Snip
episodes.summary: Lala invites most of the group to celebrate her daughter Sosa's first birthday, leaving some feeling excluded; Janet tries to make amends with a few members of the group; Tom and Michelle's bond continues to grow.

episodes.name: The Santa Clarita Trail
episodes.summary: Brittany takes the first step toward regaining her self-confidence with a mommy makeover consultation; Jasmine's growing friendship with Lala is tested on a girls' night out, leaving Michelle in the middle.

episodes.name: Mariposa Momma
episodes.summary: Danny and Nia continue to struggle with their newborn daughter refusing a bottle; As Kristen grapples with postpartum blues, her relationship with Luke is tested when their first date night out without Kaia turns into a disaster.

episodes.name: The Hive Mentality
episodes.summary: Janet's game night olive branch yields mixed results; Jesse gives Lacy a divorce update in hopes of taking things to the next level; Kristen and Luke continue to struggle with their communication.

episodes.name: All Aboard!
episodes.summary: Tom introduces his crush, Kiana, to his friends. The group takes a train to San Diego and Janet tries to build a stronger friendship with Zack. Danny starts to lose his patience with Nia. Kristen and Luke struggle on their first trip as new parents. Michelle and Lala share an emotional moment.

episodes.name: Triggers and Tiaras
episodes.summary: The San Diego trip continues with Lacy's arrival, which causes chaos, particularly with Michelle; Kristen struggles to quell her postpartum frustration towards Luke.

episodes.name: Miss Behavior
episodes.summary: Nia struggles to deal with Danny's antics during a drag pageant; Jason suffers a traumatic injury; Lala questions why Kristen blindly takes up for the Bookos.

episodes.name: 'Til Debt Do Us Part
episodes.summary: Kristen and Luke work to reconnect; Michelle opens up to Lala about the financial strain of her impending divorce and emotions run high when she surprises Jesse with divorce papers to sign.

episodes.name: Red Flags and White Claws
episodes.summary: Zack's roommate leaves, letting him and Benji test living together. Brittany recovers from surgery as red flags emerge with boyfriend Brandon. Jasmine confronts Zack.

episodes.name: Friendships Shaken, Not Stirred
episodes.summary: Zack invites everyone on a getaway to Mexico; Brittany drops shocking news about Brandon; Tom hosts a Bond-themed party where relationships are tested when Lala confronts Nia, Janet takes on Luke and Jesse leaves Michelle in tears.

episodes.name: Schwartzapalozza
episodes.summary: Zack worries about his future with Benji, who questions Danny's story. Brittany confronts Kristen for prioritizing Nia's feelings. On a Mexico trip, Kristen's travel anxiety flares, and Luke expresses doubts about their relationship.

episodes.name: Liked and Loaded
episodes.summary: Schwartz's birthday party explodes when Lala confronts Danny about his social media. Zack gets angry over how the group treats Danny. Luke and Kristen keep fighting, while Nia and Janet clash during a Sayulita day trip.

episodes.name: Hips Don't Lie
episodes.summary: Kristen faces accusations of betraying her friends. Danny and Nia clash during Zack's birthday outing, while Michelle struggles seeing Jesse with Lacy. Zack lands in the emergency room.

episodes.name: It's My Birthday & I'll Cry If I Want To
episodes.summary: Michelle and Lacy emotionally try to move on. Jesse tells Kristen a secret about her future with Luke. Janet shares her past with Lala, while tensions explode at Danny's birthday dinner.

episodes.name: Ball's Voyage
episodes.summary: Lala celebrates her 7-year sober anniversary while mourning her dog, Lily. Kristen and Luke struggle with the aftermath of Mexico and their relationship's future. Danny gets a vasectomy while Nia is away judging.

episodes.name: Guilt Tripping
episodes.summary: Jesse and Michelle take a major step with their divorce. Zack struggles with having kids with Benji. Kristen and Luke meet with a couples' therapist with mixed results.

episodes.name: Separation Anxiety
episodes.summary: Summer brings drama as couples deal with separation, new relationships, parenting challenges, fertility issues, and long-distance love. At Brittany's White Party, tension builds between Kristen, Janet and Zack.

episodes.name: Checking In
episodes.summary: Jax faces scrutiny over recent actions, admits hitting bottom and seeks help. Zack works on friendship with Brittany and relationship with Benji. Janet deals with Kristen fallout. Jesse and Michelle clash over Isabella's custody.

episodes.name: The Billionaire and the Boys' Chat
episodes.summary: Michelle faces divorce drama amid rumors. Brittany copes with Jax in mental health care. Luke shares news with Danny. Janet's party reconciliation with Kristen gets complicated by Michelle gossip.

episodes.name: The Circle of Strife
episodes.summary: During a getaway in Santa Barbara, two couples face unexpected drama when an uninvited guest arrives. As relationships strain and secrets surface, important conversations lead to pivotal moments that could change everything.

episodes.name: Grapes of Wrath
episodes.summary: During a Santa Barbara getaway, tensions rise as Jesse and Michelle clash. Danny's late arrival and excessive drinking creates problems with Janet, while Zack reveals hurtful gossip to an unsuspecting Nia.

episodes.name: Behind Closed Pantry Doors
episodes.summary: During a tense Santa Barbara getaway, friendships unravel amid confrontations. Meanwhile, Jesse deals with relationship drama, and Luke takes big steps with Kristen while quietly planning to propose.

episodes.name: Ring Around the Rumor
episodes.summary: Amidst conflict over Danny's alcoholism and his attempts at reconciliation, gossip about the Capernas emerges as Kristen defends the Bookos. At a pool party, Brittany reveals shocking news about Jax.

episodes.name: The Biggest Snake in the Grass
episodes.summary: Tensions rise between Jasmine, Janet and Jason as Zack notices changes in his friendship with Brittany. Kristen's gossip causes chaos among friends and Brittany discovers that Jax violated her privacy.

episodes.name: When One Door Forecloses
episodes.summary: Kristen and Luke's housewarming takes a turn; Brittany prepares for Jax's return by meeting with a divorce attorney; Jasmine and Melissa try to mend things with Jason and Janet; Danny is accused of overindulging again.

episodes.name: You've Been Served
episodes.summary: Jax becomes upset when he finds out about the party at Brit's; the guys take Jax to a dinner that leads to a confrontation between Jason and Danny; the tension between Nia and Janet comes to a head; Jax is blindsided by a special delivery.

episodes.name: El Coyote Ugly
episodes.summary: Luke finalizes plans for a trip to Hawaii where he plans to propose to Kristen; Janet, Michelle, Kristen and Nia butt heads during a girl's night out; Jesse confronts Aaron about the timeline of his relationship with Michelle.

episodes.name: Will You Maui Me?
episodes.summary: Unbeknownst to Kristen, a fishing trip Luke planned is where he plans to pop the question; Brittany feels hurt and left out when she learns she isn't a part of Kristen's proposal; Janet threatens to leave the trip early.

episodes.name: The Cruise from Hell
episodes.summary: Jax spoils Kristen and Luke's engagement after Brittany inadvertently reveals the news to him; Kristen and Zack are fed up with Brittany choosing Janet over them; all hell breaks loose when Janet and Kristen reach their breaking points.

episodes.name: Making Up Is Hard to Do
episodes.summary: In the wake of the cruise from hell, Janet struggles with insults Kristen threw at her; Danny and Nia look at a house as they get closer to their decision on having a fourth child; Jax and Brittany argue when discussing co-parenting.

episodes.name: There's No Zen in Resentment
episodes.summary: Jesse and Michelle experience a breakthrough in their relationship; Kristen comes to terms with her fertility journey; conflict takes the spotlight at Michelle's Zen party; Jax comes clean about his battles.

episodes.name: Reunion Part 1
episodes.summary: As the cast reunites for their first-ever reunion, Kristen and Nia, now both eight months pregnant, relive their fertility journeys. Jesse and Michelle clash over the details of their impending divorce. When the topic of conversation turns to what contributed to the demise of Jax and Brittany's marriage, Jax gets put in the hot seat.

episodes.name: Reunion Part 2
episodes.summary: Jax opens up about his sobriety journey and continues to butt heads with Brittany over his actions last summer. Jesse attempts to make peace with his soon-to-be ex-wife before Michelle revisits a long-rumored truth. Tensions come to an explosive head between the Bookos and the Capernas.

episodes.name: Reunion Part 3
episodes.summary: While Kristen and Luke reminisce over their Hawaiian engagement, the argument between the Bookos and the Capernas threatens to derail happier memories. Jesse gets called to task by Andy. Zack, in an effort to make peace within the friend group, extends an olive branch to Janet.

episodes.name: Biggest Hands
episodes.summary: Mark's hands are 20 times normal size. Fearing amputation, he avoided doctors, but worsening symptoms force him back for his daughter's sake.

episodes.name: Ugliest Man
episodes.summary: Uganda's "Ugliest Man" winner Godfrey has a rare disfiguring disorder. With 10 children and another coming, he seeks medical answers about his worsening condition.

episodes.name: Upside Down with a Twist
episodes.summary: In Brazil, Claudio lives with a condition that bent his head backward. Ahead of his 50th birthday, he wants to climb a sacred mountain. In Norway, Birgitte lives with a different presentation of the same condition. She's training for the next Paralympics.

episodes.name: Peaks and Valleys
episodes.summary: Life defined by height. In Turkey, the world's tallest woman lives with an unknown genetic condition linked to extreme growth and fragile bones, while in Brazil, the world's shortest couple navigate dwarfism and its physical challenges.

episodes.name: Face to Face
episodes.summary: Milagros lives with tumors so heavy that her face droops down to her torso. After hiding away, a health scare is forcing her out into the world. Twenty-one-year-old Lizzie is preparing to live independently even after tumors have grown over her eyes.

episodes.name: Hair Today, Gone Tomorrow?
episodes.summary: In rural India, Lalit's face and body have been thickly covered in hair since the day he was born. Doctors theorized that the hair would fall out once he reached peak maturity. Now that he's turning 20, Lalit seeks out a specialist to learn his fate.

episodes.name: Worlds Collide: Part 1
episodes.summary: Ten new survivalists from around the world are dropped into the Arctic Circle.

episodes.name: Worlds Collide: Part 2
episodes.summary: While one participant makes a devastating mistake, another gets the chance to secure a big game and secure a foothold in ALONE.

episodes.name: Building Momentum
episodes.summary: After a tumultuous week, the remaining survivalists continue to battle with settling into life in the Arctic. One participant finally gets their chance at big game, while another reaps the benefits of a well-placed trap line.

episodes.name: Cold Omen
episodes.summary: The survivalists grow comfortable in their surroundings, until the mountains signal a harsh shift ahead. As winter encroaches, one faces a dangerous predator encounter, while another begins to crack under the pressure.

episodes.name: The Land of Great Thirst
episodes.summary: In Alone's driest location yet, ten new participants must survive in the Great Karoo desert as they face extreme temperatures, new species of predators, and a host of exhausting challenges, all for a chance to win $500,000.

episodes.name: Best Laid Plans
episodes.summary: Encountering nervous prey and strange vegetation, the last surviving group rapidly discovers their initial plans face harsh opposition.

episodes.name: Thirst Trap
episodes.summary: The Desert's heat and lack of shade continue the survivalists to focus on water or risk dehydration. Some participants get creative in stockpiling this life-saving resource, while others find themselves realizing it's a little too late.

episodes.name: Finding a Foothold
episodes.summary: As the tumultuous first week nears its end, the remaining survivalists focus on regaining their footing.

episodes.name: The Tempest
episodes.summary: The survivalists finally begin to cash in on food as game proves to be plentiful. This prosperity is short-lived, however, as dark clouds loom in the distance.

episodes.name: Purpose
episodes.summary: After a severe storm, survivors assess their position. One person gambles on building an advanced shelter, while another unwittingly faces a critical situation.

episodes.name: Echoes of Emptiness
episodes.summary: Depleted survivalists struggle as wildlife remains elusive. One searches for motivation to continue while another nears their limit.

episodes.name: Weak Spot
episodes.summary: Three remaining survivalists test their endurance after almost a month in the Great Karoo Desert.

episodes.name: The Promised Land
episodes.summary: A series of misfortunes causes the surviving contestants to watch their odds of winning fade.

episodes.name: No Regrats
episodes.summary: The remaining survivalists make a final push to the finish line, but only one can win the $500,000 prize and make Alone history as the first winner in a desert climate.

episodes.name: Where's the Nanny?
episodes.summary: Young celebrity nannies head to Ibiza to launch a premier agency serving the world's elite.

episodes.name: Princess for an Hour
episodes.summary: A nanny agency lands a high-profile client seeking an actual princess, but envy and hidden truths put the business at risk.

episodes.name: I Know Your Secret
episodes.summary: The nannies investigate Leah's history as a dangerous new problem threatens to destroy the agency.

episodes.name: Coup d'Jack
episodes.summary: The nannies challenge leadership when clients dwindle, and a trip becomes uncomfortable as drama unfolds.

episodes.name: The King of Ibiza
episodes.summary: Jack's efforts to bring in new families create divisions. A surprise phone call leads to blame and conflict.

episodes.name: By Nannies, For Nannies
episodes.summary: Summer's over, a Paris invitation causes household tension, a nanny makes plans, and Sydney puts a friendship on the line.

tt34688214.title: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston

episodes.name: Tremors
episodes.summary: As tremors begin, Tom asks: Will anyone recognize the danger? He traces two Romans ignoring the warning signs of disaster.

episodes.name: Eruption
episodes.summary: As ash falls, Tom asks: Who will escape, and who will act? He follows a soldier, a mother and a boy as survival hangs in the balance.

episodes.name: Survival
episodes.summary: As the final surge hits, Tom asks: Who survives, and at what cost? New evidence reveals the fate of three real Romans.

episodes.name: My Dad is Jesus
episodes.summary: A naked woman attempts to elude police by jumping into the ocean; a man attacks a police car with a chainsaw; a woman claims her dad is Jesus Christ.

episodes.name: Dead Man Banking
episodes.summary: A woman urinates in the street during a traffic stop; a pant-less man is arrested for allegedly robbing a donut shop; two women drive to a bank with a deceased man in the car.

episodes.name: Bulldozer Battle
episodes.summary: Police battle with a man in a bulldozer; an influencer live streams a break-in during a hurricane; a man dons a kids' mascot costume to dodge authorities.

episodes.name: Topless Pursuit
episodes.summary: A topless woman leads authorities on a high-speed pursuit; a man escapes through a drive-through window with the store's cash register; an 80-year-old man on a lawnmower is chased by police.

episodes.name: Naked Shovel Swinger
episodes.summary: A naked man attacks police with a shovel; a woman refuses to leave a restaurant until she gets a free glass of water

episodes.name: Indecent Date
episodes.summary: A man claiming to be Jesus causes a disturbance at a church; a woman is arrested for indecent exposure after a blind date gone wrong; Police chase a man driving a stolen golf cart.

episodes.name: Twerking and Wrestling
episodes.summary: An allegedly intoxicated woman suggests cops lock her up; an uncle enters the wrestling ring to defend his nephew's honor; a man places items up his kilt while shopping.

episodes.name: Tripping as a Chicken
episodes.summary: A man dressed as a chicken claims to be tripping on mushrooms; a woman attempts to use a police car as her taxi to the bar; The Naked Cowboy is arrested for panhandling in Florida.

episodes.name: Naked at the Door
episodes.summary: A naked man shows up unexpectedly on a homeowner's doorstep; a Jeweler locks a woman in a vault to wait for police to arrive; police use a kid's bike to chase a suspect.

episodes.name: Poop Enforcement
episodes.summary: A woman poops in the middle of the road during a traffic stop; a fugitive gets stuck in a chimney while hiding from police; a woman crashes her car into her own house.

episodes.name: Strip Poker Chaos
episodes.summary: In Vegas, a man gets naked on top of a poker table; a mom fires multiple rounds at a police station; a citizen dressed in a poop emoji protests in court.

episodes.name: Meth Raccoon
episodes.summary: Police find a raccoon with a meth pipe in a woman's car; a man is arrested while paying his taxes; a landscaper drives a tractor into a cop car.

episodes.name: Desperate Housewife
episodes.summary: Two women are arrested for allegedly stealing 17 baseball bats; a reality show star is arrested for DUI; a couple is thrown out of a renaissance festival for disturbing a juggler.

episodes.name: I Want a Discount!
episodes.summary: A man drives a car off a cliff trying to elude police; a waitress gets flirtatious with deputies; a shopper refuses to leave a store until she gets a price reduction.

episodes.name: Dropping Pants
episodes.summary: A woman poops on a car in a fit of road rage; a man drops his pants during a traffic stop; a resident is arrested after becoming the Vice President of his HOA board.

episodes.name: A Presidential Arrest
episodes.summary: A woman walks into the station to file a police report and walks out restrained; an alleged Presidential candidate attempts to arrest a cop; a man is fueled by negative comments made on TikTok.

episodes.name: Serving Country
episodes.summary: Ariana and Hudson's breakup goes public, shocking the group. Charlie bonds with Hudson despite being iced out. At Emira's birthday, tensions with Georgia rise and Ava and Gia's feud escalates.

episodes.name: Bad Influencer
episodes.summary: Ariana and Georgia struggle to move past their exes as Charlie bonds with Hudson and Omar. At Ava, Emira and Riley's work event, Charlie's invite sparks tension.

episodes.name: The Man in the LED Mask
episodes.summary: Liam's interest in Ariana deepens, leading him to enlist Shai to help set up a night out. Georgia embarks on a new business venture. Gia hosts a girls' night, prompting a guys' night across town. As both gatherings begin to spiral, Brooks reaches a breaking point.

episodes.name: TikTok Boom
episodes.summary: At girls' night, longstanding tension between Georgia and Riley boils over. Liam leans further into his growing connection with Ariana. Brooks struggles to find his voice amid setbacks with his brand. Hudson's return to New York forces Shai to determine where his allegiance lies.

episodes.name: Welcome to New York
episodes.summary: Hudson looks for an apartment while Brooks handles a photo shoot with his mom Meredith and observes the flirtation between Charlie and his sister Chloe. After Emira's debut, the party gets out of control because of Georgia's confessions.

episodes.name: What Happens in Brooklyn
episodes.summary: Ariana and Riley reconnect after a decade apart. Charlie struggles to hide his irritation as a Brooklyn night out shifts from cocktails to chaos. Brooks and Gia update their moms, Meredith and Teresa, on brewing drama.

episodes.name: Daddy Issues and Poolside Tissues
episodes.summary: Brooks wants to approach Seth but the talk turns into an interrogation. Charlie's family meal gets tense because of his mom's boyfriend. At Gia's party, Charlie waters her so much that Riley cries, Ava is furious and he seeks to flee.

episodes.name: Apology Not Included
episodes.summary: Charlie hints at crushing on a friend during his apology tour. Ariana and Hudson get their perfect apartment. Brooks' dad calls him mom-dependent at a museum. Ava criticizes Ariana's style at Chloe's party.

episodes.name: Zero Bucks Given
episodes.summary: Brooks snaps while styling Meredith's caviar event. Ava's entrance causes drama. Charlie ditches a huge bar tab on Hudson and Riley. Riley confesses her real career dreams to Kandi. Georgia and Charlie clash intensely.

episodes.name: Boardwalk of Shame
episodes.summary: Ariana's excitement for her mother Kim's NYC visit fades when Hudson pushes her to set financial boundaries. Brooks' birthday bash on the Jersey Shore descends into chaos when Georgia and Charlie's feud takes over the party, dragging Ariana, Riley and Gia into the crossfire.

episodes.name: Shore Losers
episodes.summary: The morning after Brooks' birthday blowout, the crew wakes up determined to have a fun day on the water. Ariana and Georgia patch things up, but Georgia's pitch for a bowling alley club incites new drama. Ava's absence leads Emira wondering if she's telling the truth.

episodes.name: Gutter Balls & Breakup Calls
episodes.summary: Tensions linger as the group heads back from Jersey with Riley calling out double standards and Emira dropping a bombshell. Brooks finally steps out of Meredith's shadow. At Georgia's bowling event, Ava's loyalty sparks confrontation. A flash-forward reveals a shocking twist that leads to a living situation nobody saw coming.

episodes.name: Show Me Your Hands
episodes.summary: In Colorado, a driver opens fire and sparks a high-speed pursuit that ends with a dramatic standoff. In Ohio, a man ignites gun battle with police, and in Florida, deputies race to find a missing autistic boy before he comes to harm.

episodes.name: Race Against Time
episodes.summary: In Florida, desperate to stop a carjacking suspect, officers chase him through busy downtown streets. In Wisconsin officers rush to save victims of a brutal mass stabbing, launching a manhunt before the suspect can strike again.

episodes.name: Danger Zone
episodes.summary: Oceanside police hunt down a violent criminal after a brutal domestic shooting. A reckless driver hurtles towards thousands of runners during a 10k event, and officers risk their lives to save residents trapped in a raging house fire.

episodes.name: Danger in the Woods
episodes.summary: In Arizona, a police officer and firefighter respond to a serious vehicle collision. In Florida, police pursue a suspect who chooses an unexpected escape route, and in Georgia, officers hunt an armed man hiding out in the woods.

episodes.name: White House of Horror
episodes.summary: In Indiana, a possible murder-kidnapping leads Evansville Police into an armed standoff with a suspect barricaded inside a house. In Florida, deputies launch a desperate rescue mission to save an unconscious man trapped on a runaway boat.

episodes.name: Murder in Progress
episodes.summary: In Georgia, officers find a car with no sign of the driver, Aaron Davis, who was last seen with his best friend Brandon. Brandon seems cooperative when officers search his home, but when they sense foul play, he takes off running.

episodes.name: Flames and Floods
episodes.summary: In Wisconsin, deputies fight for their lives in a burning home as a violent suspect seeks to end his life. In Tennessee, officers face a race against time to rescue innocent civilians trapped in the raging torrents of deadly flash floods.

episodes.name: Risking it All
episodes.summary: In New Mexico, a car chase ends dramatically with lasting consequences for a lieutenant, and a lone officer must keep her cool to detain a homicide suspect. In California, officers battle a raging car fire to rescue the trapped driver.

episodes.name: On the Edge
episodes.summary: In Ohio, Police fight to save the life of a woman held at knife-point, two repeat offenders lead police on a perilous pursuit, and in California, a Sheriff's helicopter unit battles to save a man clinging to a cliff.

episodes.name: 'Til the Wheels Fall Off
episodes.summary: In Oklahoma, a drug dealer leads police on a perilous pursuit down a busy interstate. In Michigan, an officer comes under fire from a masked gunman, and in Missouri, a sting operation goes wrong when the armed suspect takes off on foot.

episodes.name: Catching Fade

episodes.name: Grown Woman

episodes.name: Stalemate
episodes.summary: Bobby finds himself in hot water as Eli nears the truth about him and Simone. Hunter makes a shocking discovery about his paralysis. Richard has a surprising run in.

episodes.name: Unpleasant Surprises

episodes.name: Power Play
episodes.summary: With tension at an all-time high inside the White House, Hunter must orchestrate a plan to regain his power. Elsewhere, Jason is formulating a way to escape the compound.

episodes.name: if These Walls Could Talk
episodes.summary: The White House is on high alert after Victoria and Eli's lives become at risk. As Richard's life unfolds, Simone's vengeance for Victoria spirals out of control.

episodes.name: In Due Time
episodes.summary: Eli and Victoria see red after a harrowing move by Hunter. Nancy is adamant on getting revenge.

episodes.name: Between Two Fires
episodes.summary: Victoria devises a scheme to remove Hunter once and for all, but Priscilla has other plans. Richard has had enough of Nancy and decides to take matters into his own hands.

episodes.name: The Breaking Point
episodes.summary: Richard faces the consequences of his actions. Eli makes a definite decision.

episodes.name: Seeing Is Believing
episodes.summary: Sam presses forward on his plan to control Nancy and protect Richard. Eli calls in the big guns to remove Hunter once and for all.

episodes.name: On Your Mark
episodes.summary: Eli has put his plan in motion to finally get Hunter, while Nancy discovers what it means to anger the men inside the White House. Meanwhile, Sharon's life is now at jeopardy.

episodes.name: The Fight for Power
episodes.summary: Drugs and alcohol put Allan in a precarious situation. Sam wants Richard to think twice about what he wants.

episodes.name: Crossed Boundaries
episodes.summary: Victoria implements her plan to get Hunter out as Allan becomes Donald's pawn. Meanwhile, Sam pays the ultimate price for his sins.

episodes.name: The Time Is Now
episodes.summary: Victoria devises a plan to lure Hunter from the residence. Sharon and Dale make a huge discovery.

episodes.name: Ironclad

episodes.name: A Plan Deferred

episodes.name: Lies and Alibis

episodes.name: Air Tights

episodes.name: Counterblow
episodes.summary: Constance drops a bomb on Hunter. Victoria and Jason fight for their lives.

episodes.name: Episode #6.22
episodes.summary: Allan's actions catch up with him. Simone warns Eli his latest move could bring blowback

episodes.name: Mind Over Metal
episodes.summary: Three smiths hope to cash in when they are given the opportunity to win money after each challenge; after two tough rounds, all three smiths head back to their home forge to recreate the serrated Dussage.

episodes.name: Two Faced Challenge
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must forge a blade with not one, but two Damascus billets. After an intense round, the remaining smiths experience a Forged in Fire first when they are faced with an unexpected twist. Then, two challengers head back to their home forges to recreate a pair of deadly Ginunting swords. Who will be the last smith standing and take home $10,000?

episodes.name: J. Neilson's Secrets of the Forge
episodes.summary: J. Neilson, Forged in Fire judge and notorious breaker of blades, reveals his secrets of the forge in this special inside look. For the first time ever, J. will disclose his most infamous blade breaks and the tricks to becoming a Forged in Fire champion.

episodes.name: On The Road: Texas Showdown
episodes.summary: We visit Texarkana, Texas and the Bill Moran School of Bladesmithing, where three of their top smiths will be put through the ultimate test.

episodes.name: On The Road: Montana Face-Off
episodes.summary: Heading to Bigfork, Mont., to the New Agrarian School where three of their top smiths will be tested like never before; after two grueling challenges only one will go on to represent the New Agrarian School in the finals for the ultimate grand prize.

episodes.name: On the Road: Appalachian Showdown
episodes.summary: In the heart of North Carolina's Appalachian Mountains is the world-renowned Clay Spencer Blacksmith shop, where three of the forge's best smiths will be tested. After two grueling rounds of competition only one will be left standing. The winner will have the chance to compete against other smiths from across America to determine who will win the ultimate grand prize.

episodes.name: On the Road: Kalamazoo Combat
episodes.summary: Head to Kalamazoo, Michigan to Combat Ready Art where three of their top smiths will be tested like never before. After two brutal challenges only one will go on to represent Combat Ready Art back at the home forge for the ultimate grand prize.

episodes.name: On the Road: American Champion
episodes.summary: At the home forge, four of the nation's top smiths will go head-to-head in one final battle. After three grueling challenges, which smith will come out on top, becoming the first ever Forged in Fire: On the Road champion, winning $20,000 for themselves and $10,000 in forging equipment for their shop?

episodes.name: The Frankenstein Challenge
episodes.summary: Four smiths must "Frankenstein" together discarded pieces of scrap steel to make their blades; after a horrifying round of testing, the remaining two smiths retreat to their home forges to create the legendary Crusader Bible Falchion.

episodes.name: Chef's Special
episodes.summary: Four smiths get cooking when they are tasked with forging a chef's knife; only two head back to their home forge to build a brutal hog splitter.

episodes.name: Springtime for Napoleon
episodes.summary: Four smiths spring into action when they must forge signature blades from the metal found in various household items; after a couple tough rounds, two smiths head to their home forges to recreate the Napoleon Presentation Saber.

episodes.name: Instruments of Death: Masters of the Siege
episodes.summary: In a Forged in Fire twist unlike anything we've ever done before, four teams of expert builders are tasked with making some of the largest and most notorious siege weapons ever seen on the battlefield. From war hammers to battering rams to ballistas, which team's weapons will be strong enough to take down the competition, earning them $20,000 and the first ever title of Forged in Fire: Instruments of Death champions?

episodes.name: Beat the Unbeaten: Mastering the Mystery
episodes.summary: In this special Forged in Fire competition, two previous champions go head to head in a 5-hour forging round making their own signature "can mai" blades for the chance to compete against one of our titans of the forge. They'll battle Gladiator of the Forge Jesse Hu, Super-champ Collin Sage, or our Undefeated Judge Ben Abbott, in an extreme 8-hour challenge where they'll have to make the Medieval Sword of Mystery. Do they have what it takes to Beat the Unbeaten?

episodes.name: Beat the Unbeaten: Conquering the Kachin Dao
episodes.summary: Two previous champions battle it out for the chance to compete against one of our titans of the forge: Gladiator of the Forge Jesse Hu, Super-champ Collin Sage, or our Undefeated Judge Ben Abbott. But first they must face off in a brutal 5-hour challenge, where they have to pick a box and build a signature blade using whatever method is inside. The winner will then have 8 hours to make the intimidating Kachin Dao. Will their weapon stack up and be able to Beat the Unbeaten?

episodes.name: Beat the Unbeaten: A Cutlass Above
episodes.summary: For the first time in Forged in Fire history, two champions will return for the opportunity to go head to head against one of our titans of the forge. After facing off against a fellow champ, only one smith will remain and be tasked with making a M1917 Naval Cutlass, against either Gladiator of the Forge Jesse Hu, Superchamp Collin Sage, or our Undefeated Judge Ben Abbott. In one of the most intense and heated battles ever seen, will they be able to beat the unbeaten?

episodes.name: Beat the Unbeaten: Off the Hook
episodes.summary: Two previous champions will face off in a grueling 5-hour challenge, making a blade inspired by Hollywood for the chance to duke it out against one of our titans of the forge. In a final 8-hour battle, the winner will face either Gladiator of the Forge Jesse Hu, Superchamp Collin Sage, or our Undefeated Judge Ben Abbott making the extremely challenging Kelewang.

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Test of the Best
episodes.summary: For the first time in years, our top champions will step back into the Forged in Fire arena to face their toughest competition yet: one of our expert judges.

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Machete Master
episodes.summary: Some of our top Forged in Fire champions head back to the forge to face their toughest competition yet: one of the judges. Tasked with making an intricate Vaquero Machete, will this former champion have the skills to prove they have what it takes to Beat the Judges?

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Tackling the Tizona
episodes.summary: Two of our top Forged in Fire champions head back into our arena for a chance at taking on one of our judges. Tasked with making the legendary Tizona of El Cid in eight hours, will this former champion be able to vanquish the toughest competition of all and beat a judge?

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Shamshir Showdown
episodes.summary: In this final "Beat the Judges" competition, two former Forged in Fire champions duel it out in a 5-hour round making a pichangatti to earn the right to go head-to-head with one of our formidable judges.

episodes.name: Champion's Cup: Quest for Glory
episodes.summary: In the first of a three-episode event called the Champion's Cup, three winning smiths return for a shot at forging their name in Forged in Fire history.

episodes.name: Champion's Cup: Survival of the Fittest
episodes.summary: In the second of a three-episode event called the Champion's Cup, three smiths return for a chance at becoming a two-time winner and having their name forged in history.

episodes.name: Doug Marcaida's Secrets of the Forge
episodes.summary: Doug Marcaida, Forged in Fire judge and edged weapons specialist, reveals his secrets of the forge in this special inside look.

episodes.name: Champion's Cup: Hunt for Victory
episodes.summary: In the finale of the three-episode Champion's Cup event, three smiths return for a chance to become a two-time winner and have their name forged in history.

episodes.name: Ben Abbott's Secrets of the Forge
episodes.summary: Ben Abbott, Forged in Fire competitor turned judge, reveals his secrets of the forge in this special inside look. Ben will disclose how he's been able to stay undefeated and divulge his most coveted tips and tricks to become a Forged in Fire champion.

episodes.name: Siberian Forge
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths turn snowflake canister Damascus into a deadly Yakut knife in freezing temperatures. After brutal testing, two competitors head home to tackle another Siberian staple: the Cossack Shashka sword.

episodes.name: The Melting Point
episodes.summary: The competition heats up when four competitors must use a metal never before seen in Forged in Fire history: copper; known for its tight forging window, the smiths must pay attention to their heat or risk melting their blades.

episodes.name: Old Friends, New Era
episodes.summary: Vicki returns as Shannon and Tamra clash after a heated confrontation. Gina questions her relationship status, Emily rebuilds her home life, and Heather adjusts when her mother relocates from New York to California.

episodes.name: Not on My Bingo Card
episodes.summary: Gina throws Emily a drag bingo-themed 50th birthday party where the ladies lean into the wisdom of their age. Shannon befriends Carmella, but Vicki has questions about Carmella's past. Heather and Jennifer butt heads over transparency in their friendships with Tamra. Emily confronts Tamra about their work relationship, causing egos to clash.

episodes.name: Revolving Door of Lies
episodes.summary: Shannon is loving the single life as Jenn preps for her wedding; Emily reveals a heartbreaking family issue; Tamra opens up about her past trauma in therapy; Heather deals with problems at her Beverly Hills mansion.

episodes.name: Old Faces, New Places
episodes.summary: Katie extends an olive branch to the group; Tamra faces off with longtime foe Gretchen Rossi; Emily and Shane's parenting styles clash; Gina exposes a shocking allegation that leaves Shannon feeling completely betrayed.

episodes.name: Knee Deep in Lies
episodes.summary: Heather finds herself negotiating a birthday conundrum; Jenn and Katie support their kids as they move in and out; Shannon introduces her dating bench to Emily and Gina; Katie's apology attempt to Shannon is met with an explosive reaction.

episodes.name: Judge, Jury and Jenn
episodes.summary: Tamra's plus-one to Heather's birthday party catches Gretchen and Slade off-guard. Katie finds herself at the center of rumors regarding her connections with bloggers. Tamra and Jenn have a one-on-one that takes a turn for the worse.

episodes.name: The Big Uneasy
episodes.summary: The heat builds up at Gina's housewarming party when Jenn learns that Tamra has been showing unflattering photos of her from the past; the group visits New Orleans and embarks on a riverboat cruise.

episodes.name: What Voodoo You Do?
episodes.summary: As the New Orleans trip continues, the ladies keep the festivities going by attending a dog parade and making voodoo dolls; Jenn continues to question the intention behind sharing the unflattering picture; Shannon remains cautious.

episodes.name: The Truth Will Not Set You Free
episodes.summary: After Tamra's dramatic departure from New Orleans, Shannon finds herself in murky waters when she shows up late to a gator boat tour; Katie's explanation of contacting an influencer leaves her closest allies to question her stories.

episodes.name: Truth Tellers & Lie Detectors
episodes.summary: Emily throws a Persian New Year party for the women, but has a surprise activity to uncover the truth behind the rumors swirling in the group; Heather's family's future is up in the air as she waits for offers on her Los Angeles mansion.

episodes.name: Whine or Champagne?
episodes.summary: The ladies embark on dueling trips as Tamra invites Shannon, Jenn and Gina to Temecula in an effort to rebuild her friendship with Shannon; Heather takes the opportunity to host an adult sleepover in Beverly Hills with Emily and Gretchen.

episodes.name: Not So Funfetti
episodes.summary: Tamra decides to give herself some space from Gretchen; Emily and Shane are more in sync after receiving a diagnosis for Luke; Jenn expresses her concerns as Dawson preps to leave for the Marines.

episodes.name: Hoedown Throwdown
episodes.summary: Tamra meets with Katie in hopes of uncovering the truth; Shannon and Jenn's friendship continues to blossom when they engage their dogs with a pet psychic; Heather hosts an event for the Trevor Project.

episodes.name: Going Dutch
episodes.summary: Shannon hosts a bridal lunch for Jenn; Heather opens up about her relationship with her father; Gina and Travis celebrate their family being back together; Tamra and Eddie prep to be empty nesters; the ladies head to Amsterdam.

episodes.name: Tulip Service
episodes.summary: As the Amsterdam trip continues, the ladies visit the famous tulip fields where Jenn and Shannon´s friendship is called into question. Emily tries one last time to broker peace between Tamra and Gretchen.

episodes.name: A Source of Discontent
episodes.summary: The ladies enjoy several local activities in Amsterdam; Emily receives a distressing call from Shane; Heather finds comfort in visiting her parents' former home before spreading her father's ashes; Gina struggles with a scandalous rumor.
